title: Fake
content:
They show you that you’re going to receive a prize, but all the important details are buried in tiny print that nobody really reads. You only see the part that makes you think you’re getting something for free.

You choose your prizes, and then you find out that you have to participate every single day, make purchases, and meet certain requirements. And even if you do everything they ask, you’re not guaranteed to actually receive the prizes, because apparently they can still be entered into some kind of drawing later.

They lure you in by making it look like you are guaranteed to get prizes after purchasing a certain number of items. Then you end up having to cancel subscriptions, delete the app, and even block them through your bank because they have your payment information. They also collect your home address, phone number, email, and all the other information you provided.

All of this happens because, like everyone else, I fell for the promise of getting free prizes. It’s all misleading and ridiculous. Do not fall for this. Never trust these “free gift” promotions.

title: ⚠️マジで、詐欺アプリ⚠️
content:
無料系には絶対に手を出すな＋普通の買い物も要注意

普通に他のネット通販と同様に購入 は物理的に可能だが、明らかに間違ったものや欠品ありが届くことあり(返金対応も実績含めあるが、返送用に要梱包、場合により減額返金あり)

ボトルネックは、無料ゲット系(「ファームランド」ほか)
結局、はやくプレゼントがほしければ、水やり等のために要買い物

カスタマーサポート(CS)は、「時間はかかりますがコツコツ継続すれば必ず報酬を受け取ることができる仕様になっております」とは(コピペテンプレ文の繰り返し貼り付け対応)にて言う
vs
実際は、無料で水やりできるのがMax10回/日なので、年単位で考えなければならず、いくらビジネスとはいえ、卑怯であまりにも時間かかりすぎ

しかも、他人を招待したらさらに水やりできる とあるが、知人友人は、以前このアプリで同様の被害(明らかに間違ったものが届いた実績あり)で、誰も Temu を信用していないため、協力を仰ぐこと不可

2ヶ月間で35,000円以上、水やりポイントを稼ぐため複数回に分けて買い物をして、残り10円→5円ときたら、5円分を100%やれば終わるはずなのに、事後、後2円分とまた100%やらなければならなくなったので、2円分が終わったら、1円分ずつ計200%分以上必要見込

どこが、本当に無料でもらえる なのか...

少なくとも...
・異常な高難度と誤解を与える表記
・CSのテンプレ文の繰り返し貼付対応
・はやく欲しいなら要買い物と事実上の巻上
・上層部責任者の権限者は基本不在
→いつまで待てばいいか目安も提示不可
・CS「 協議中、上層部の勤怠はCSでは不明」
(他の民間企業でもトラブル発生時に職権のある対応責任者が、休日でも出てくるはず)

以上から、無料系には絶対に手を出すな＋普通の買い物も要注意

title: Little Shops
content: The five-stars is for real! What I found is that Temu consists of many little shops that you’re purchasing from. So, yes, the items are made and shipped from China, BUT, I like the fact that I’m supporting many “little shops” instead of just big stores like the U.S. has. What I have learned is that there are many of these little shops that sell “fakes”, or replicas of the same well-made item at another little store on Temu. (So Temu is similar to EBay, but without bidding, and much more affordable!) You may want to make a list of the stores you get good items from, so when you reorder, you don’t get a non-legit item (or fake). I have fun just adding cool things to my Wishlist: on item, scroll down, passed the reviews, and you’ll see the little empty heart and “wishlist “ by that. Tap heart to save in your wishlist.

title: For What It’s Worth
content:
If you a smart shopper and realize nothing is free, then you’re ahead of the game. Buying t-shirts is one thing, they’re always a good buy, but shirts with sleeves is another, those are for cleaning cars.
Guitar accessories, cables, strings, pedals, guitars those are great, but tools, no, they’re garbage.
In fact any tools, they’re knock offs made of cheap metal which bend or break.
Phone accessories, yes great buys here, cables, chargers, phone holders, etc, same with electronics, cassette players, recorders, external cd / dvd players, all good, safe buys.
I’ve even bought a brace for my wrist for $3.00, which was the same one I bought from my doctor’s office for $65.00.
So to sum up, as the old saying goes, “Let the buyer beware,” if it seems to good to be true, then it usually isn’t, be smart, don’t buy it.
Example: those inexpensive flashlights, junk! You get what you pay for, cheap plastic painted to look like metal. Hope this review helped you. Remember, TEMU doesn’t design or build these items, they are more like a clearing house.

title: TEMU EXPERIENCES
content:
I have used app and Website for TEMU overall the app has been great; but there are too many gimmick promotions to just get to ordering ie get large discount but you go through ridiculous schemes to get it.  Or because they value you as a return customer and you get three up even 6 items free, you pick items then you have to order a said amount to get them.  But they don’t give an honest overall amount—you get one item; repeat; repeat etc.Ultimately you spend more than you intended and sometimes more than if you just ordered what you wanted and came across item and added it on.  Product wise, during the past 2 plus years I’ve ordered product they have been good quality and if something was wrong Temu corrected immediately.  But recently I have ran into newer stores they’ve allowed to be of really lesser quality.  The latest was a gorgeous looking sweater alleging cashmere; and I can tell you it was not cashmere.  It had glass cut devote all over front and a hole as big as a quarter smack in the front center, chest area.  And they had planted one of the stones poorly right over it deliberately trying to conceal it.  And all the decor was poorly glued on the the straggly long so-called strings of cashmere. TEMU needs to do better checking cloths, jewelry and even some furniture items.  TEMU wants to be a Global seller of products; but it will go down hill fast in the US if it does not!  Also TEMU needs to stop trying to fake reviews and altering them.  The sweater above I gave a detailed bad review and when I checked after posting I found it was altered saying just one word Excellent, which I deleted immediately and sent them a rebuking response.
TEMU did send QR to return sweater to them for Quality Review and after receiving it, sent email a Full refund was being returned through my means of payment.  Waiting for that now.

Prices are reasonable especially compared to the terrible US economy.

The only real complaints I have are the pesky notifications, the wishlist being capped, and also sellers can blacklist you for returning incorrectly sized items, so be careful of that and make sure you measure accordingly. Sizes tend to run small, and sometimes sellers may use AI or low quality items- just return them, especially if they are not as described.

title: Scam
content: This app uses a ton of loopholes to not be legally called a scam, but it is one. They give you all these flashy rewards to get you to spend money without noticing. No shopping site is going to give you thousands of dollars worth of stuff, they aren’t going to give you tons of money back, the coins are worthless, and the stuff to buy is all junk. It’s a bunch of knockoff garage that’s marked up. If you wanna buy stuff for cheap just use Ali express. Ps, to claim any rewards or money you have to spend ridiculous amounts for a shopping app that’s supposed to be “cheap”, it’s not stuff you’d want either. The rewards make you pick from a randomized list, pretty much all of it is stuff nobody would ever want, and again none of the prices make sense. I saw a guitar amp for $250 on the rewards, then in a different color for $60. Which one is it? Probably neither since it’s a brand I’ve never heard of.

title: Misleading and poor quality
content:
I’m extremely disappointed with my experience with Temu. The way the daily Cash Rewards are presented is, in my opinion, completely misleading.

For example, if you place a £60 order, the app explicitly tells you that you have £48 in Cash Rewards, making it appear that your £60 order effectively costs only £12 after the reward. But that is not how it actually works. You then have to keep making additional purchases every day for a certain amount in order to unlock and claim the supposed reward.

So when the app tells you that your £60 order is effectively only £12 after Cash Rewards, I consider this deceptive and deliberately misleading to consumers. The £48 is not simply money that you can claim after making your £60 purchase — there are further conditions and additional spending involved.

And unfortunately, the product quality is just as disappointing. The sizing is inconsistent, the materials are extremely poor quality, and many of the products don’t even deserve one star in my opinion.

In my view, Temu’s marketing activities are based on deception and misleading customers. The way these promotions are designed and presented gives consumers an impression of savings that, in reality, come with significant additional conditions and spending.

Overall, I feel very misled by the way these offers are advertised and presented in the app. Customers deserve much clearer and more honest information about what they are actually getting and what they need to spend to receive these so-called rewards. I certainly won’t be falling for it again.

But that is not how it actually works. You then have to keep making additional purchases every day for a certain amount in order to unlock and claim the supposed reward.

So when the app tells you that your £60 order is effectively only £12 after Cash Rewards, I consider this deceptive and deliberately misleading to consumers. The £48 is not simply money that you can claim after making your £60 purchase — there are further conditions and additional spending involved.

And unfortunately, the product quality is just as disappointing. The sizing is inconsistent, the materials are extremely poor quality, and many of the products don’t even deserve one star in my opinion.

In my view, Temu’s marketing activities are based on deception and misleading customers. The way these promotions are designed and presented gives consumers an impression of savings that, in reality, come with significant additional conditions and spending.

Overall, I feel very misled by the way these offers are advertised and presented in the app. Customers deserve much clearer and more honest information about what they are actually getting and what they need to spend to receive these so-called rewards. I certainly won’t be falling for it again.

title: Good, but watch out for traps
content:
Overall, my experience with Temu has been good, but there are a few things you really need to be aware of.
1.	Quality can be very inconsistent. You have to choose carefully, because it’s easy to end up with something cheap and poorly made. And when the item only costs a few dollars, you may not even want to go through the hassle of returning it.
2.	The misleading promotional ads are way too much. My advice: don’t believe the “free gifts” promotions. If you’re lucky, you might actually get a $5 or $10 discount, but I wouldn’t count on getting the free items they advertise.
For example, I’ve been stuck on the Farmland game for two weeks. It shows that I can get four free items and that I’m already 90% of the way there. It says I just need to keep watering a few more times. However, the amount of progress you get from each watering keeps decreasing. At the beginning, zero? water could represent around 10% progress, but toward the end, even 10 drops of water may only give you 0.02%.
The biggest problem isn’t even that the game is difficult—it’s that the rules seem to change as you get closer to the goal. That kind of one-sided manipulation makes the whole experience feel really frustrating and, honestly, pretty unpleasant.
Overall, Temu can be worth trying, especially for inexpensive items, but I would strongly recommend being cautious about product quality and especially about its “free gift” and game-based promotions.

title: Don’t chase the free deals, use Temu like a good app for discounted items
content: Honestly, Temu is better used as a place to find cheap stuff you actually want, not to chase their “free item” offers. Temu isn’t bad and you’ll get what you purchased most of the time, it’s just that if you try and follow the pop ups on free items, you aren’t gonna have any money left. It gets frustrating because you start with a deal that looks like you’re getting a bunch of stuff for almost nothing, then suddenly you have to pay a fee, buy something over $20, and then another offer pops up. Before you know it, you’ve spent $25–$30+ just trying to get the “free” stuff, when you could’ve spent way less simply buying the items you actually wanted. At that point, it doesn’t even feel like you saved money. The same mindset applies to AliExpress and SHEIN: use them to find discounted stuff you genuinely want or need, not to get trapped chasing the next promotion.

title: Nothing you can’t get on Amazon for the same price.
content:
Been using Temu for a while and bought quite a few things. The app has really annoying popups pushing signup offers that are not genuinely free, just a dark pattern designed to harvest sign ups rather than offer real value.

Lately most items advertised on the app I could get locally at about the same cost and with far less waiting time. The quality of goods seems to have dropped, and anything decent is priced about the same as on UK sites or Amazon anyway.

Good for quirky one off items, but the wait outweighs the few pounds saved. Quality standards on my orders have been questionable. I would not buy anything electrical from it, since items sold through the platform often bypass the UKCA and CE safety certification you would expect from a UK retailer or Amazon UK, and enforcement on individual sellers is patchy.

The product reviews are also mostly false or paid for. This is not just a personal impression, review manipulation on Temu and similar platforms has been widely reported, so star ratings are not worth trusting.

title: Addicting
content:
I love Temu! I have purchased so many things that I have never seen available elsewhere. The prices are fantastic, you just need to watch for all the great coupons and credits. For the majority of items, even  clothing, everything is very well-made and has excellent detail. Temu has great customer service. If an item arrives broken, or doesn't arrive at all, there is no hassle getting a refund.

Rules I follow: Always check the descriptions and take them literally. If it says "faux" or "dyed" or "artificial" or "glass", believe it! Always look for the sizes in inches; if none, don't buy it, or else find it from a seller that shows the size. If a figurine is resin or 3D printed, I assume I will have to paint it myself (which I love to do). If you buy a lot of things, it is easier to keep track of received items if you write each review as you open each package. Happy Shopping!

content:

I reported that I never received my order, but despite providing evidence, Temu initially told me it was “delivered” and refused a refund. They have now changed their explanation and claim it was delivered to my neighbour, even though I have not received the parcel and nobody has contacted me saying they received it.

The delivery photo provided does not show my property and instead shows the parcel inside an unknown vehicle. I also received no delivery notification from EVRI by email or text.

I have provided Temu with evidence of my address and a written statement, but they continue to refuse my refund.

I am sharing this experience so other customers are aware of what happened to me. If your parcel goes missing, keep all evidence, screenshots and delivery information.

Again, if it’s not listed as free in my cart, it doesn’t exist so I don’t complete that purchase & just leave them there for future reference. I do love the site but every purchase does feel a bit like a gamble, hoping I receive something of relatively good quality. Lately, I have received higher quality items & have been pleased. Just read every detail & you’ll like it too!

title: Pretty good app!
content: The app is really easy to navigate and super nice to use. It does do a LOT of promotional things that don’t actually really help you out much (it gets pretty annoying to have a promotional “deal” every time you open the app). I’ve bought so much for so cheep it’s crazy. The app does have a $10 spending minimum for every purchase, you can do this by purchasing more things or a $10+ item. This may sound like I’m just hyping it up but I genuinely enjoy the app. It does have slower shipping because all of these things are made so far away (expect 2-3 weeks for it to be delivered. If it’s late they give you credit or refunds for it). The items VERY rarely have a chemical smell (in my experience) and you do have to make sure you check the sizing charts. For U.S sizing and for people on the bigger side it’s a little harder to find things but when you figure out measurements for different areas and look at those, you’re practically going straight for success.

title: Temu pro & cons
content:
Temu has a vast array of items to choose from from clothing toys household appliances yard tools storage containers cupboards furniture and more they have an excellent return and exchange policy and they tend to ship fast. The items are well-made and their packaging is durable. In my opinion the little games that they play are annoying and the time limits they set are constricting . The offers they give ,if your screen should go black even for a moment knocks you out and it’s very frustrating. if you pay attention to the price listings of identical items listed throughout their screens you will see that there is a big fluctuation in price range for the exact same item anywhere from five dollars to $25 down to two dollars so you do have to pay attention to what you’re getting in comparison shop which shouldn’t even be a bait and switch problem. Overall I do like Temu but those few things I would like to see changed for the better for the consumer

title: Goodbye Temu
content:
Temu is a great platform that offers good quality items at an affordable price.

I absolutely loved Temu and I’ve been using it for almost 3 years now.

But now everything is just ruined with these new EU import and what not charges.
Now if one wants to buy something worth of 50€ they have to pay like 30€+ or more!

To me this is really devastating, I can’t afford this new system and honestly, I wonder which customer on Temu can!

Temu is supposed to be a place that’s affordable, so with this new change, it completely takes away the value of Temu. I can’t shop at Temu at all now, I tried to see if there was a way around this, but I was unsuccessful.

Therefore I have to relocate to another platform that doesn’t have this system. This is a really hard decision because I love Temu so much.

title: Great Deals, Unique items, free stuff and awesome Customer Service
content:
I have been using Temu for more than a year now. They have great prices and the quality of most of the items is good. They carry many unique items, which is awesome. When I have to make a return, it is very simple and quick.
There are free games to get free items and I have been success, in the past. It does ask you to get friends to join to increase your chances but all my friends have already joined.

Shipping is pretty fast for most items and it’s free when you buy stuff shipped and sold from Temu.
They refund $5 if shipping takes longer than it states, even for other sellers.

The biggest complaint I have is there are a ton of pop ups every single time you open the app.  I participate in some of them but I wish I could figure out how the promotional things work exactly. It is sometimes confusing. I rarely get the coupons or percentages I earn because it’s unclear and because they come after I’ve spent my budget. They expire quickly. Their high value coupons are not what I would consider to be high.

That being said their customer service people reactivated my coupons for me. I really appreciated that they were willing to work with me, which is not a common practice for other retailers. That makes all the difference.

Thank you, Temu.

title: DESESPERANTE
content:
⭐☆☆☆☆

La experiencia de compra se ha vuelto desesperante.

Cada vez que abres un enlace o intentas ver un producto, la app te obliga a pasar por una interminable secuencia de “rifas”, “premios”, “gira la rueda”, “raspa y gana” y otras pantallas diseñadas para retrasarte. Literalmente puedes tardar mas de dos de minutos esperando solo para llegar a la página principal y, hasta entonces, por fin ver el producto que querías desde el principio, si es que lo logras.

Entiendo que quieran promocionar ofertas, pero esto ya no se siente como marketing, sino como una estrategia para manipular el tiempo de uso de la aplicación y simular descuentos mediante tácticas de gamificación excesivas.

Si alguien abre Temu es porque quiere comprar o consultar un artículo, no jugar un videojuego para poder acceder al catálogo. Debería existir una opción clara para omitir todas esas promociones con un solo toque.

Mientras no prioricen la experiencia del usuario sobre sus métricas de engagement, seguiré considerando esta una de las experiencias de navegación más frustrantes entre las apps de comercio electrónico.

title: My experience with Temu “Free Gifts”
content:
Temu showed me that I had only 0.5 coin left. I invited a genuinely new app user, and it only reduced my remaining amount to 0.2 coin. The reward became smaller instead of simply finishing the offer.

I ended up asking several people to download/use the app because I thought I was almost done. Please be aware that “just one more invite” may not actually mean you are one person away from receiving the gifts.

Sharing this so others can decide for themselves before spending their time and asking friends to join.

I was shown that I needed 0.5 coin. After inviting a new user, I needed 0.2 coin. After another successful invite, I needed 0.05 coin. The goal kept changing as I got closer.
Think twice before asking your friends to download an app for this promotion.

title: Fabulous
content:
Absolutely love this Temu app.

So easy to use.

Spent hours on it and have bought such great things.

Yes, you need to really take your time when wanting to buy something.

The photos show the “original “ item that has been copied by another manufacturer.

This means something might look fabulous on Temu’s app but turns out completely different when you get it, especially the fabric.

Something might look like weaved fabric only for you to receive horrible polyester brrrrr

Other than that it’s fabulous.

Returns are super easy, as long as it is sold by Temu. There are other sellers on the app too and I have read reviews that they aren’t so keen to accept a return or give refund when product isn’t as it should be.

We have never had this problem with Temu.

If it a small item they sometimes let you keep it while giving me a full refund. Of course if it’s above a certain amount of money they still offer you a refund which is paid out as soon as the return centre has receive the package and all is in a resell state.

Super happy with Temu.

title: Great deals and features, but watch out for misleading listings and annoying pop-ups.
content:
The Temu app is full of great values and unique features, but it definitely requires you to be a careful shopper. You have to pay close attention to the product descriptions because items are often presented visually larger than they actually are. Additionally, the list pricing can be very misleading; listings frequently display the price for the lowest quantity while showing a photo and description of the highest quantity—like showing a 100-count pack of pens with a $20 price, but when you open the item, the $20 price is for a 20-count option. Opening the app can also be a chore, as you’re instantly bombarded with intrusive, time-consuming animations for coupons and discounts that require a purchase to use, taking multiple clicks just to dismiss.
That being said, the perks keep me coming back. I really appreciate the $5 on-time delivery guarantee and the excellent price adjustment feature, which lets you request a partial refund if an item’s price drops after you buy it. Being able to buy customized items without minimum orders or setup fees is also a huge plus. The app is honestly kind of addicting, and I will definitely continue to use it despite the annoying quirks.

title: 次々と購入したくなるけど…
content:
広告のルーレットで100%offが出たので、買わなきゃ損！と購買意欲を刺激されました。
3点購入したら1点無料で、早速購入手続きをしたら直後に◯時間以内に購入したら50%offと出て、2回ほど追加購入しましました。

クチコミに、梱包が最悪とあったので覚悟はしていましたが…商品パッケージは破れていたり開いたままだったり、日本の通販では100%クレームになる状態でした。

商品自体も、写真よりも安っぽかったり、少し違ったりです。

組み立て式2段ワゴンは、コンパクトな梱包で届きました。カゴの大きさが上段のほうが一回り小さく、入れ子式になっていたからです。
それを無理に繋げるので、正面から見た仕上がりが『I I』ではなく『ハ』の形になり少し歪みます。

フライパンは、取っ手が付いてない状態で届き、自分で取り付けました。

顧客目線ではなく、いかに送料を安くできるかが重視されてるという事です。

中国国内での常識・クオリティがそのまま海外に進出したといった感じですね。

ワゴン・フライパン・エッグケース・ステンレスまな板・ステンレス保冷剤・枕・ショーツなと10点以上の商品を購入しましたが、まともに使えているものは
ステンレスまな板・保冷剤とエッグケースだけです。

title: Poor Customer Service and Incorrect Delivery
content:
I am very disappointed with my experience. My order was marked as delivered, but I never received it. The delivery proof photo clearly shows the package was left at a different property, and the GPS location also does not match my address. It is obvious from the evidence that the parcel was delivered to the wrong location.

I contacted customer service, and they initially told me they would investigate and provide a cash refund. Later, they changed their decision and claimed their investigation showed the package was delivered to the correct address, despite the clear evidence showing otherwise. I feel that my complaint was not properly reviewed.

As a customer, I expected better service and a fair resolution. Instead, I feel ignored and disappointed. Because of this experience, I have lost trust in Temu and do not plan to shop with them again unless they resolve this issue properly.

title: Temu v AliExpress
content:
I’ve found this site quite interesting and it seems to be designed for both Small & larger individuals, which is why I decided to check out Temu. The same items are available on AliExpress, but unfortunately, there isn’t any clothing in my size there.

In my opinion, AliExpress offers quicker delivery times, and you can order for just £8. Temu, on the other hand, has a £15 minimum order and delivery times are a bit longer, with some items still in transit that I ordered over a month ago—okay, I get it! Temu does keep you informed about the status of your order, but the delivery times for some items are a bit of a concern. AliExpress has been much faster in my experience. It’s a shame they don’t offer clothing for larger European sizes. However, I’m definitely in favour of Temu for its wide range of sizes.

title: まずは中国商法を知るべき
content:
我々とは違う文化、歴史を持ち政治形態も違う中国という国が良く理解できるアプリ。
中国の文化や商慣習を何とか世界共通レベルに近づけようと努力している姿は昔の日本と同じなのかも知れません。

Temuに限らず中国と付き合うには中国を知る必要があります。
嘘、大袈裟、紛らわしいは当たり前です。
日本では消費者庁や警察に泣きつくレベルの商いは通常営業です。
割引も商品内容も誇大広告が前提です。
良く調べれば認知バイアスを利用したただの悪徳商法です。
日本やG7諸国であれば。

しかしTemuは中国ECアプリです。
彼らの願いはたった一つです。
「とにかくなんでもいいから一つでも多く買ってください！」
そのためには悪徳なんて、もーまんたいです。
こちらは彼らの願いを聞く代わりに彼らが用意した割引アイテムを上手く利用して送料無料で格安なコスパ最強商品を得れば良いだけです。

ここでいくつか越えるべきハードルが出て来ます。
同じ商品でもストアや在庫数、時間帯やセール時期、購買履歴など状況により価格が大きく変動します。
これはTemuがプログラムで随時価格を変動させているからです。
詳しくはAIに聞いてみてください、なかなか面白い裏話が聞けますよ。
この実態を理解し把握するには、ある程度の時間が必要です。
現実にはリタイアした年金受給者や暇を持て余した不労所得者でなければかなり難しいと思います。

手軽に、素早く、お得に買いものをしたい人には向きません。
高額割引に騙されて割高で必要のない商品を買わされてしまいます。
そういった人にはAmazonやヤフショが最適です。
Amazonは最短当日配送、ヤフショはpaypay特典と安心安全な商品が売りです。

Temuは商品到着まで10日前後、時間がかかっても必要な商品を1円でも安く日本語で買いたいという方にはオススメできます。
また返金処理が迅速かつ確実、シンプルな事も非常に重要です。
アリババやタオバオも激安ですが、やはり中国語や英語ができないと商品内容の確認や返金依頼などがかなり面倒くさいです。

それらに比べると少し割高になりますが、Temuであれば日本語で全く問題ありませんし、割引を上手く使えば送料無料なのでタオバオやアリババの激安レベルを軽く超えてしまいます。

私は以前はタオバオを利用していましたが、両国税関の輸出入規制、代行業者手配、国際送料、返金処理等の理由からタオバオをやめてTemuに切り替えました。

気になる商品はアプリ内でお気に入りに入れておき、買いたい時に同じものを探したり、クーポンを見ればその時安く出品している出品者から購入できます。
直接クレジットカードを登録したくない方は、PayPayや ApplePay等で購入できますので、そちらを選ぶと良いかと思います。

星3の理由は、以下です。
・煽りまくりな演出がかぶるとちょっと面倒臭い。
・注文および配送のページが見づらい。

content:
結論として、「 1万2000円分のポイント貰えます！！ 」的な奴を受け取るには3万円以上は掛かりますよ。

なんかパチンコみたいな演出の後「 あと120ポイントで特典受け取り！！ 」とか書かれてた時、私の例にはなりますが、最初の購入で120ポイントもらえると書かれていたのに、貰えずに( 100ポイント程は貯まりましたが )その後のポイントの加算では『 ポイントの加算に失敗！成功までもう一歩 』とか『 ポイント加算！0.4ポイント加算します！！ 』みたいな吐き気を催す醜悪さでした。

ですがここで記述している不満は全て、ポイントや特典など、初めて使う人を呼び込む為の蟻地獄的な要素が本当に地獄だという不満だけで、扱う商品に関してはまぁまぁです。
ですが商品に付いているレビューのほとんどが、外国の人のレビューを直訳したようなものばかりで( 私の見た商品が偏っている可能性もありますが)不安に駆られるものである事も確かだと思います。

content:
So I like Temu for buying cheap things that don’t need to be high quality, just functional, like decorative items etc,

My only problem is with the gifts and how all that actually works!
It says to add 5 items to basket and make one purchase of 10£ min spend
And get the five free, this is not true, you get the cheapest free items in your cart, and only one of the five free items!

If you want the other free items! It makes you make another purchase of 10£ min spend!  And so on!

I know it’s only a small thing, oh no I didn’t get me five free items! But don’t make me think I’m getting something I’m not ya know! Seems slimy and false advertising to me!

I genuinely like the cheap items, that for their price and delivery time are decent, and I like that if you spend a certain amount you get free delivery! I just wish the gift or free item, etc were worded correctly saying you only get one free gift per perched item of 10£ and less trickery into getting you to buy and buy and buy!

Kinda sad!

Regardless of this I spend hundreds of £’s on Temu mostly on garden products and pop the flower seeds are usually grass seed so I’ve been screwed over with that but on the whole the gardening stuff is good.

title: Beim Kaufen aufpassen
content:
Ich habe sehr viel bei Temu eingekauft und auch meinen Mann dazu gebracht, dort zu bestellen. Ich habe immer gesagt, dass Temu einen besseren und schnelleren Kundenservice als Amazon hat – bis ich einen Bildschirmspiegelungs-Adapter mit einem Gutschein gekauft habe.

Der Adapter, den ich erhalten habe, war mit meinem Handy nicht kompatibel. Deshalb wollte ich ihn zurücksenden. Außerdem hat man das Recht, einen Artikel innerhalb von 14 Tagen ohne Angabe von Gründen zurückzugeben.

Nachdem ich die Rücksendung einleiten wollte, erhielt ich jedoch ständig Fehlermeldungen, sobald ich auf die Rückgabeseite weitergeleitet wurde oder den Kundenservice kontaktieren wollte. Interessanterweise funktioniert der Einkaufsbereich weiterhin problemlos – man kann ganz normal weiter einkaufen.

Für mich wirkt das wie eine Täuschung. Vielleicht warten sie einfach darauf, dass die Rückgabefrist abläuft.

Wenn man mir gesagt hätte: „Gemäß unserer Richtlinien erstatten wir den Betrag für zurückgesendete Artikel als Temu-Guthaben“, hätte ich damit kein Problem gehabt. Aber das, was hier passiert, zeigt für mich, wie wenig kundenorientiert man in solchen Fällen handelt.

Seien Sie beim Einkaufen vorsichtig.

title: Seit über vier Wochen keine Rückgabe möglich - trotz ständigem Kundenservice Kontakt
content:
Sehr enttäuschende Erfahrung mit Temu. Ich habe Ware bestellt und wollte mein gesetzliches Rückgaberecht nutzen. Seit vier Wochen versuche ich, ein Rücksendeetikett bzw. überhaupt eine Rücksendeadresse des Händlers zu erhalten. Trotz zahlreicher Telefonate mit dem Kundenservice wurde das Problem nicht gelöst.

Besonders frustrierend ist, dass die Mitarbeiter im Callcenter immer wieder nur dasselbe Standardprotokoll durchgehen. Eine echte Problemlösung findet nicht statt – auch nicht durch Teamleiter oder angebliche Eskalationsteams. Die Weiterleitung an höhere Stellen führt praktisch zu nichts.

Mein Eindruck: Wenn ein Händler die Rücknahme verweigert oder Verbraucherrechte nicht einhält, scheint Temu keine wirksame Möglichkeit zu haben, den Kunden tatsächlich zu unterstützen. Der Prozess wirkt chaotisch, unkoordiniert und ohne konsequente Nachverfolgung.

Für mich ist das ein sehr schwacher Kundenservice und ein klares Warnsignal bei Rückgaben oder Reklamationen.

content: There are the infamous memes and jokes about things from Temu being much much smaller than the photographs. Items are already very, very cheap, but if something seems too good to be true, again read the descriptions carefully and the reviews. I got an imitation microphone that claimed it was a namebrand, it wasn’t the legit item because I have several to compare it to and figured it wouldn’t be because of the low price, but also figured at that price point, it would be at least a good backup microphone. I haven’t had a chance to A – B compare it yet, but seems to be well worth the cheap price. I’m sure it won’t be as durable as the real item which is known for being able to stand up to rough road use.

title: Muy buena experiencia de compra, con margen de mejora
content:
La plataforma ofrece una gran variedad de productos y, en general, mi experiencia de compra ha sido positiva.
Como sugerencia de mejora, sería muy útil que la plataforma permitiera crear varias listas de deseos personalizadas y asignarles nombres. Actualmente, con la gran cantidad de productos disponibles, una única lista de favoritos puede resultar difícil de organizar. Poder separar los artículos en diferentes listas según categorías, proyectos o intereses facilitaría mucho la experiencia de compra y la planificación de futuras compras.
Mi otra observación se refiere a la entrega: en una compra reciente, el paquete fue enviado a una sucursal de DHL bastante alejada de mi domicilio, a pesar de que existe una sucursal mucho más cercana. Sería excelente que se optimizara también este aspecto de la logística.
Fuera de estos puntos, estoy satisfecha con la plataforma y seguiré utilizándola.

content:

Das Ergebnis: Die Rücksendung bleibt hängen, die Erstattung kommt nicht, und man steht ohne Unterstützung da.
Keine direkte Kontaktmöglichkeit, keine verlässliche Hilfe und am Ende wartet
man vergeblich auf sein Geld.

title: Fabriken gegen die Natur
content:
Temu steht für mich nicht für Qualität, sondern für billige Massenware. Millionen günstiger Produkte werden hergestellt, gekauft und kurz darauf weggeworfen. Den Preis dafür zahlt nicht der Kunde, sondern die Natur.

Jede Fabrik, die endlos minderwertige Wegwerfartikel produziert, hinterlässt Spuren auf unserem Planeten. Wir sprechen über Rabatte und Prämien, während die Erde die Last von Verschmutzung, Ressourcenverschwendung und Bergen von Müll trägt.

Vielleicht ist die größte Respektlosigkeit gegenüber der Natur nicht das, was wir wegwerfen, sondern das, was wir ohne Sinn produzieren.

Die Erde braucht keine weiteren billigen Produkte. Sie braucht mehr Verantwortung.

title: 5 years at Temu
content:
I have been a customer for over 5 years with Temu. Over a period of time I have purchased a large variety of items. Most of them have been nice, a few not so nice which is to be expected. My most serious complaint is that  someone stole the numbers from my debit card and Temu  charged me for all of their purchases.I have wrestled with them for 8 months. Even though this happened before couriers took pictures, Temu had no tracking numbers for the illegal charge’s destination. Nonetheless, this is not yet settled and I recently made charges through the Colorado Attorney General concerning both Temu and US Bank. So my advice is to check your credit card charges daily, and keep an eye on your bank statements.
Also, do not bother playing their games. You will never come out the winner. On the “Credit” game” you would need to spend approximately $20 for each penny gained to win each of the  usual $100 credits.  So my advice is to purchase only what you need . Most of the time if you simply learn the rules, keep a check to make sure all your items are in your packages, I enjoy the items I have purchased

title: Nutzung
content:
Ich benutze Temu jetzt schon seit zwei Jahren.

Bei der Produktqualität bin ich schon ein paarmal enttäuscht worden.

Hier muss man aber die Rezensionen aufmerksam lesen sowie die Produktbeschreibungen.

Oft ist es jedoch so, dass das Produkt viel besser präsentiert wird, als es am Ende tatsächlich ist. Hier sind die Bewertungen der Nutzer sehr hilfreich.. ich bestelle oft Dinge für Zuhause oder auch für die Arbeit.

title: Paket und Geld weg
content:
Ich habe im Mai eine Bestellung im Wert von über 60 Euro aufgegeben. Laut der Sendungsverfolgung des Versanddienstleisters J&T Express wurde das Paket als „zugestellt“ markiert. Bei mir ist die Lieferung jedoch nachweislich nie angekommen.
Seit Wochen versuche ich nun, das Problem über den Temu-Kundenservice zu klären. Statt einer Erstattung oder einer echten Nachforschung werde ich jedoch permanent nur hingehalten. Mir wird immer wieder standardisiert mitgeteilt, dass mein Ticket an die „Verwaltung“ oder an „höhere Mitarbeiter“ weitergeleitet wurde. Passiert ist seitdem absolut nichts.
Ich habe für Ware bezahlt, die ich nie erhalten habe, und der Kundenservice verweigert eine angemessene Lösung. Da der direkte Support blockiert, sehe ich mich gezwungen, diesen Fall nun öffentlich zu machen.
Ich fordere Temu hiermit nochmals öffentlich auf, den Fall umgehend zu prüfen und den gezahlten Betrag für die nicht gelieferte Ware zu erstatten.

title: Read carefully the descriptions
content:
Not happy with Temu.  A lot of cheap and poor quality goods that look good in photos but are generally a lot smaller than pictured.  A lot of unfair marketing practices encouraging people to buy more.  4 items for free, but after selecting my choices I then he ad to purchase a lot of goods to obtain the free items.  When buying the required items and paying for them I then discovered that I would only receive one free item and would have to make further purchases on another day to get the next item free. A big con as I tested this buy adding further items to a certain amount to my basket only to be offer a small discount of less than £2 with no mention of the next free item.    In all fairness, some of the items I have purchased have been good quality at a fair price but also a lot of rubbish goods.  Yesterday I received a batch of 50 paint brushes plainly showing 1” on the metal binding but only measure just under 20mm and the laughable part is that there was more loose bristles in the delivery bag than there was in the brushes.  They went straight into my rubbish bin.
Best tip I can offer is double read and study the description before buying especially delivery times as some items will be shipped overland from the other side of the planet.
Happy shopping and be careful.

If you’re going to advertise discounts, the total should actually reflect that—not trick customers into paying more. Also, I’ve only shopped here once or twice, and I don’t even want to imagine how much money I might have already been overcharged without realizing it. I definitely won’t be using this app again. Double-check your totals if you do.

Overall I have had a very pleasant experience with Temu.
Thank you.

無料で○点ゲットなどという名目でいくつものゲームが出てきますが、時間をかけて最終段階まで進んだ所で必ず友達を招待しなくてはならなくなります。まだ皆さんの言うような迷惑電話やメールはありませんが、無料ギフト5点を貰うのはほぼ不可能なのでゲームやるだけ無駄です。何時間も損しました。
また、間違った商品が届いた時の対応、告知なくゲーム内容の変更で欲しい商品が消えたり。
その都度サポートに連絡しましたが対応はマニュアル通りの定型文。
更に始めた頃はすべての商品がびっくりするくらい安かったがどんどん値段が上がっている。
その上原材料表記と実物の原材料が合致しない商品、商品画像と比べ物にならない画像詐欺な商品。クレーム入れるもその事実を認めない運営。
クソとしか言いようがありません。
ゴミみたいなクオリティ(100均レベル)の物が400円台など。
その後、「1点（最低購入価格なし）購入で26500円クーポン進呈」なるものが出ましたが、その1点が商品ページの期間限定割引を無視した高い価格な上、クーポンもまとめた26500円ではなく、〇円以上で500円、1000円などに分割されており、期限は発行から3日間という短さ！ふざけてる！
これ以上続ける意味ないですね。残ってるクレジット使ったらアンスト決定です。
というかAppStoreが承認しているのが謎。

title: Wow
content:
I finally gave Temu a try last week; I’m impressed a little. I did not give five stars because the games are a bit deceptive along with the free items selection. My daughter would get free items by sending texts and emails and if those she sent a link to downloaded the app to view and/or purchase items she would get her picks free. They now have the games to get free items; I have figured out if you do the farmer watering game every day several times a day you can build up to get the items you picked without buying anything but you must be patient. The items are also given out over a couple of weeks; the key is to pick carefully because in the beginning I didn’t realize what I was doing and I have a couple of repeat free items. There is also a time limit to choose your free items so be mindful of the time while choosing. I have found when browsing items I previously bought to always check for the price adjustment from the seller because I got almost $5 back today in adjustments. My son is not a fan as he said may items are cheap; I understand his logic as we raised them to buy quality products and to take exceptional care of the purchases so they will last many years; however, if I pay $8 plus $3 shipping for a cordless drill with two battery packs and it last 6 months it is worth what I paid. To date the only item I purchased without a 5 star review is a t-shirt I bought for $1.06. The t-shirt runs a little small so no hot water and no dryer but the lettering was the cheap flat rubber stuff like in the 1980’s so also must be washed inside out. All in all I have a good experience with this app.
Temu, I do recommend you allow us to choose what type of updates we want for the shipping process; currently it is a bit confusing. Letting me know the order was received, shipped, and out for delivery is good enough; I do not need to know the specifics by text message because I am getting way too many messages at all hours of the day. The tracking number tells us the specifics so it is redundant to receive so many messages. But…… thank you Temu.

title: Scammers! Don’t believe the lies
content: So this app is worth it for the sales, the ones that are offered by the individual sellers, but never trust Temu as a company or any of their deals and promotions. Ever. It’s all a scam. I fell for it. So many times I’ve started one of their deals and backed out because I realized I would have to spend more money than it’s worth to get the deal. This time they offered to reimburse me 100% if I spend $100. So I did it. Stupid. After I had spent the money and they said my order met the conditions, the reimbursement came up as a 30$ discount and $70 in coupons, all of which needed to have more qualifying orders in order to use and expiring in 24hours. What a lie. They said my reward would be $100 credit, as that’s what I chose from the 3 options. Credits don’t expire, but what they sent me wasn’t the credit they said it would be. They weren’t even real rewards, as they required you to spend more money and they expire in 24 hours. So they flat out lied. I’m sure they have protected themselves legally with some fine print somewhere that says they have a right to change any deal, at any time, without prior notice, but what they are doing is a scam. It’s deceptive marketing. It’s tricking current and active customers out of their hard earned money. They should be ashamed of themselves. Never trust them to do right by their own customers. Ever.

title: At times infuriating
content:
I came to Temu after no one would ship to me on AliExpress. I never had this issue until right around the time Trump put tariffs on China. After that 99% of items cannot be shipped to me. And so far I have not been able to get any sort of explanation as to why.

So that’s the backstory of how I got here. The app is ok. Funding terms is easy and there’s always something interesting but you need to read very carefully everything and if the description doesn’t tell you everything about the item then walk away.  If you want quality then you will pay up for it.  If something seems too good to be true it usually is. Sometimes you get lucky on the cheap items and get something useful but that’s like 1 out of ten. The retail prices they list are a joke. Like $159 for a mop but their prices is $13. So you are getting an amazing deal right? Definitely look at the dimensions of an item. They are photographed and sometimes shopped to look much larger then actually are. Also read read read the reviews of products and learn to filter out the bot reviews that are always giving 5 stars.

The worst thing about this app is all the sneaky deals they shove in your face and you need to listen to their BS before you can escape. Most of the time. You will be required to spend upwards of $400 to get a big reward. If you may not have to spend more than $44 to get a few free pics. It’s from a limited pool of Items.

title: Great App if used correctly.
content:
I purchase a lot of my custom printed products through this app and my customers love them.

If you use Temu right you will get some high-quality products that don’t cost a fortune. Here are my tips for using Temu.

1) Make sure to search for products with 4 Stars or above. It filters out most of the bad quality products

2) Make sure the product has a lot of reviews posted and read them. There are sometimes customer’s pictures of the products in the reviews which show you exactly what you’re getting.

3) Read the description carefully and don’t be destructed by offers that pop up.

4) A lot of the products are sent with Evri so bear that in mind before purchasing. I personally have had little to no issues with this but I know plenty of people that do. I am lucky to have a very nice husband and wife that deliver my Evri stuff. They always make sure it is safe and dry.

title: Magnets are great!
content: I have used Temu several years. I learned from a friend to verify sizes before ordering anything and have had no problems there. I have had both returns and refunds with no problems if they were from Temu but if you order from a “Lical” shipper in the USA you are pretty much on your own. They have updated so now you can contact the 3rd party so it may be easier now. I ordered litter a few years ago and only received 1 of the 3 containers ( you could only order sets of 3). I should have read the reviews and I would have known better. Be a shrewd shopper. 1) check the listed size and do not order if there is any doubt 2) be sure to check the reviews, especially the low stars ones and see if people are using products or rating when the package comes 3) do check you products, most stores will gladly send missing parts or exchange items. 4) The MAGNETS ( real/ natural ones) are great and I even got the tiny ones for magnet boards and had to pull hard to get them apart. The others I bought stick to ceiling nails soundly and metal frames of doors. I bought some tiny ones for craft/ fridge decorations are they occasionally will slide if overloaded but can hold 3 sheets grandkid art without a problem ( you may initially have trouble pulling them apart if they are less than 0.5mm because of their strength. Happy Shopping!

title: 返品無料じゃない
content:
返品送料無料じゃない。全部自分持ち、気をつけて。5回目くらいから不良品が多々送られてきた。返品したら返品送料振り込まれず。1600円の商品1110円かけて返送しないよ、こんなことなら。それなら350円の詫び代貰って商品送らず終われば良かった。発払いで送れと指示したのにこれは無い。着払いで皆送って。詐欺に遭わないで。あちらの誠意は無いから着払いで送って。電熱ブランケット、モバイルバッテリー、AirTagもどきで不良品だったから、それ以外の繊維品は造りは荒いと思うけど使えると思う。やはり少しだけ高くてもAmazonだな…不良品ほぼ当たらない。同じ中国製品でも検品の質が違う。日本製は全然レベル違う使い心地だし。
こんなに不良品送ってくるTEMなんなん。日本流通と比べて梱包荒いとか造りが甘い、バリもあるの安いから我慢してたけど…返品無料に嘘があるから、捨ててもいい金額のものだけ時々買うか…って感じ。基本不良は捨てるしかない。時間と労力と更なる金銭の負担苦に。最近TEM自体も高いし、Amazonの方が安い時あるから時代はAmazon一択になってくる早いし梱包我慢できるレベルだし安い

Putting that information on social media just tells your audience you lack the ability of being a smart consumer. Lastly, Temu customer service and return policy just takes the customer experience to another level and that’s why I choose to Temu for me and my family.

content:
I love Temu! Most of the time, the items are great value for money, and returns are straightforward if you’re not happy. I also appreciate that price adjustments are honoured where applicable.

Overall, though, I really enjoy shopping on the site and the majority of what I purchase is excellent quality and good value!

title: 皆さんの不満に回答します
content:

・届くのが遅い→まぁ仕方ないかな。ちゃんと届くのだから。

・0円、クーポン等→仕組みが今でもよくわからないので、そもそも使わない。普通に買って安いのだから。
・対応→0円商品が届かないのでクレームしたが、対応は良かった。どうやらそれは全員に届くのではなかったようだが、分かりづらかったお詫びにといって5000円割引きクーポンを発行してくれた。でもやはり使い方よくわからなくて使ってないけどね(笑)

title: Better than I expected
content: I’ve probably made around 15 purchases now from Temu. I’m based in the UK, items coming from China can take around a week but a lot of the larger items are shipped from local warehouses in the UK so it’s only a couple of days. Found some great deals on there. The offers they give you like 3 items for £0.01 you have to ignore. They don’t make it clear at all and I imagine it catches a lot of people out. You have to spend around £150 on items shipped from China before the offer will kick in, you can’t buy from local warehouses but they only let you select items from local warehouses so I don’t believe it’s actually possible to get those offers advertised. Luckily I’ve never fallen for it. That’s my only gripe, other than that it’s been great.

title: Almost perfect shopping system
content:
Every item I have searched Temu has.
No one beats Temu.  The prices are the lowest. They fluctuate often and they let you know if your favorite items are discounted further, so it is exhilarating to shop.
Some products you get what you pay for, and the descriptions and photos are left to be desired, otherwise the quality is great.  Ask questions before buying.  You can’t lose.
Great return policy.  It cannot be matched.
The couriers take more and more photos over time.  First, of the package, then with the door, then residence, then residence with your driveway which is not necessary and not private. Don’t let this happen to you, and specify on delivery instructions.   I hope Temu changes their terms and requirements regarding photos they acquire.
Fortunately, email is provided for customer service, and the company steps in if the vendor does not contact you within a decent amount of time.   It doesn’t happen often, and the vendors always seem happy to chat about their products.
Understand the Temu free item promotion.  It remembers items you have shown interested or viewed in the past.  You must buy items to get some free during their promotions, which is not unusual marketing, but many times the app keeps prompting to buy more before releasing the free items.
Sometimes the shipments come in great timing, especially the ones ordered locally.  Most times the wait is long because of importing, but it is worth the wait.

title: Great Customer Service
content:
I’ve been using and purchasing from Temu for over two years, both for my retail store and for personal items, and overall my experience has been very positive. Temu has consistently offered a wide variety of products at competitive prices, which has made it a great resource for sourcing items for resale as well as everyday personal purchases.

Like any large marketplace, you do need to be careful and read descriptions closely. Some sellers are excellent and very accurate with their photos and product details, while others can be less precise. I’ve learned to check reviews, measurements, and descriptions before purchasing, which usually avoids any issues.

That said, what truly sets Temu apart is their customer service. On the rare occasion when I’ve had a dispute and a seller was unwilling to resolve it or accept a return, Temu’s customer service stepped in and made it right. They’ve consistently been fair, responsive, and willing to stand behind the buyer. Knowing that Temu will support you if something goes wrong gives me confidence to continue ordering, especially for my business.

Overall, Temu has been a reliable platform for both retail and personal shopping. With a little attention to detail when selecting sellers and products, it can be an excellent and dependable marketplace. I continue to use Temu regularly and would recommend it to others, especially small business owners looking for variety, value, and solid customer support.

title: Does temu think I’m stupid?
content: I used a “get up to 90% off” and got 86% off, and found an endoscope, and found out I’m paying a slight mark up. Good thing I didn’t order it before looking at the same one in my cart. The same one in my cart was less than 13 dollars, and with the 86% off, I found that the item cost a little more. Temu tries to make you feel like you’re getting a better deal, but you’re actually paying a markup. Update: I tried the 99.9 percent off offer, and paid what it said to pay. It says only 7 dollars left, I added a 9 dollar item, and then it said 6.55 left?! It’s clearly trying to nickel and dime me. I’m canceling those orders and then deleting this disrespectful and deceptive app from my device. I thought I could get good deals, but as it turns out, they try to scam you blind. I might be stupid, but not that stupid. And I better be able to cancel these orders, That have been placed with just one click, and no confirmation option, and then got me by surprise. It should ask if I’m sure I want to check out for prize and show how much is left, not just place the order without my consent. I guess Chinese companies like to trick you into buying something you didn’t consent to. I just tried Ali express, and it gave me 2 welcome gifts, nothing expensive, but the app seems true to itself. What I like to see, is transparency, not opaqueness. And temu is a perfect example of opaqueness. Hopefully Ali express won’t stiff me like this one did.

title: 5 Star rating, but read review for full context.
content: All in all, there is very little to criticise with this app: the service, quality, value and range of products are all very very good.  Bear in mind that this is a volume and value shopping app and you won’t be disappointed.  Do make sure you read the description of any products you order as selecting by photos alone may be slightly misleading.  I’ve only had an issue with a delivery once and eventually it was resolved satisfactorily.  All in all a great app and service.  My one main criticism would be TEMU’s UK delivery partner, EVRI.  But if you keep track of your order’s progress you can ensure that the parcel is received safely.

title: SHEIN、temu使ってるがSHEINの方がいい
content:
長年SHEIN使ってきてあまり不満はありませんが、temuには何個か不満があります。
国内発送とやらで個人で出品てるのか分かりかねますが、配達予定日を過ぎても発送すらされていないことが何回かあります。
発送元に連絡しても返信が帰ってきたことはありません。そこでtemuのカスタマーが入ってきますが、急いで業者に発送させるよう指示を出したと定型文しか送られてきません。出品者に直接連絡をしたいから会社の番号を教えて欲しい、国内発送でどこの県なのか、その出品者過去に発送しなかったことはないのか等聞いても全部一緒の答えで、急いで発送するよう通知を送りましたとしか来ません。
問い合わせの意味全くありません。
有人対応にしてもマニュアルがあってコピペして打ってるのか分かりませんが、同じ対応または上位支部の方に引き継ぎますと言われどのくらいで引き継がれるのか聞いたところ24時間以内と言われましたがその上位支部から連絡来たことはありません。
個人出品者か分かりかねますが何度もこう連絡が来なく発送されないということがあまりにも多すぎます。
発送に対しての注意事項などを詳しく見ると自然災害等では保証なく返金等もナシのようです。正直言って発送元と連絡も取れない。
temu側も何も対応しない状態で出品者が自然災害の為発送、返金出来ないと言われる可能性もあると思います。
またtemu側は長らく発送されないと確実に届けるという半面その次の文にキャンセル申請の画面を出してきます。本来なら届いてる時期に発想すらされていない、何回も問い合わせしてるのに意味なし。
一応配達完了日時過ぎても届かない場合は600円分のクレジットが来ますが、こんだけ迷惑かかってクレジットはあまりにも不誠実です。クレジットなんて要らないので連絡の取れない個人出品者等規制をして欲しいです。

title: Temu review
content: I am a plus girl, and girl friends you know how costly plus size is. I love these clothes. The colors,the fit. If having a problem talk to Temu hit head set symbol. Some clothes have fabulous material, others more thin. Honestly that is ok to me because I read what the material is. My advice to all of you is measure your body.. they are 90% on point, also know your body type, read the detail, it will say if sheer, if stretchy, what other people rate, especially people ordering your size. If a 5 x fits a person perfect, most likely will fit too. If you’re a petite plus woman make sure you say petite plus when looking at clothes. The only problem I have had is have gotten a couple wrong things. Not actual Temu problem, rather packing problem, Temu is working hard to fix this problem , to make your shopping easier. Also read measurements, especially jewelry. You might think those earring were bigger, but the size was actually displayed. ( don’t give a bad rating because you didn’t read, that is ridiculous). Just have fun. I know I do! Enjoy

title: Temu is like a box of chocolates
content:
I struggled between giving Temu a 3, or 4. It is quite frustrating that you honestly don’t know what you’re going to get when you order from them. Forget the reviews. Most people don’t take the time to review.

They’ve sold 4,000 of something, and have 240 reviews. That should have been a red flag for me. I now go immediately to the negatives, and read them. Here’s the thing. If I pay 5.00+ for something that the quality is worse than something I get at the dollar tree here, well…no. That’s not right. You can make a quality product at a reasonable price, and STILL make money.

I finally settled on a 4 star BECAUSE Temu is making money. They do realize some of the stuff is going to be junk, so they are very good about their refund policy. As long as they continue to be fair about giving me credit, when I get a subpar product. I will continue to use them. Just if you could PLEASE stop with so many ads on Farmland. If I didn’t bite the first 7 times you offered me UP to 4000 things of water in the SAME ad…what makes you think showing it to me 25 more times will change my mind? You will NOT wear me down. You just make me determined to NEVER click on that ad to purchase something. Thank you.

title: Trickery
content:
I do enjoy the vast selection of items Temu has but I think all will agree their dealing are shady as hell. I try my best to pay close attention to what I purchase if I don’t the add will have me believing I’m purchasing a 10pc outdoor patio set with set then I’ll receive one cushion cover. Sometimes they hide the fact that it will be 4 months before item ships. a months becauseď there is 100% chance you will have one or more items billed to you that you never purchased. You will have to spend months gathering evidence that you never purchased nor received items and you may still not received credit. Example that happened to me  after arguing with Temu for couple months that i never purchased nor received an item they still refused to offer credit so I contacted seller about the charge but did it in a way not to draw attention to the purchase and they replied to me that they had never sold anything to my account. I think great now I have proof yo get refund. I sent it to Temu and they still refused to give credit end of story.
And those time consuming games they rope you into saying make purchase and get X number of items free.  They will keep billing you one item at a time and you will never know what total smoint you have to pay but they hint at it’s only 1 small purchase.
Like I said it’s a shady place to buy from and they will rob you at some point regardless is how careful you are

title: DM
content: Temu represents one of the worst consumer experiences I have encountered. Products are made from extremely low-quality materials, many items appear fake or poorly manufactured, and none of them match the advertisements. The images, discounts, and offers are misleading and exaggerated, creating a false impression to attract buyers. What actually arrives is often defective, unusable, or completely different from what was promised. As a result, returns are frequent, yet the return and refund process is intentionally difficult, slow, and discouraging. In my opinion, this business model relies on deceptive advertising and substandard products to extract millions of dollars from consumers. It appears to depend on the assumption that many customers will either not return the items or will suffer for months trying to recover their money, allowing the company to profit from consumers who cannot complete the return process. Such practices should be formally investigated by consumer protection authorities, and if these violations continue, the platform should be restricted or banned, subjected to criminal accountability, and required to pay substantial compensation to consumers who have been harmed, until it fully complies with consumer protection laws and honest advertising standards

title: Grateful and otherwise
content: I want to be that person that leaves a small eco-footprint. I really do. When I remodeled my house I made sure 99% of the remodeling supplies came from and/or were made within the U.S. (except for the cabinet hardware). But then I found Temu. Whenever I see something at a local store, I take a pic and upload it to Temu and most of the time I can find the very same item at a much cheaper cost. For a while I felt tremendously guilty for having consumer items shipped from overseas, but then I learned that not all of Temu items armed from other countries! Local businesses can advertise and sell their products via the Temu site! So while I still want to be conscientious of that footprint, I feel less guilty. Mostly because of the money I’m saving. I’m not a wealthy person (not even close) and I have to be mindful of my expenses. Temu makes it easy. I’ve bought skincare, clothes (not always the best quality but sometimes GREAT quality - hit or miss on clothes and shoes), jewelry, household items, cookware, holiday and home décor, pet supplies, washable rugs … so much!!! I have to admit it’s now my go-to site for shopping. I won’t buy anything until I’ve compared it to Temu’s offers.

title: いろいろ買ってみて思ったこと
content:
インテリア、小物を探してネットサーフィンしていてTEMUと出会いました。
他のどのサイトでもなかったものが、こちらにサイトにあったので、買いたいと思いましたが、初めてのサイトだったのでちょっと不安でした。
しばらくいろいろ考えて、こちらのサイトについて、いろいろ情報収集してから、恐る恐る購入してみました。
結果は大正解でした。
写真通りのものが届き、期待通りのものでした。
これに気を良くして、衣料品やら生活小物類やら、いろんなジャンルのものを買ってみました。
買っていく中でわかったのですが、日本人の品質に対する評価と外国の方の評価に差があることに気が付きました。
日本人はやはり高品質のものを求めます。
この私もそうです。
TEMUでは、日本人の期待に添えないものもたくさんありますが、苦情や返品に対する姿勢が、とても丁寧です。

この姿勢がある限り、私はこれからも安心してTEMUを使わせていただきます。

I’m very pleased with TEMU.

content: After being a faithful customer for years and buying tons of stuff on Temu, they shipped me a glass air fryer that was shattered into a million pieces. That was the bare minimum and required me to substantially more work than filing a dispute through my credit card company.

title: 返品も無料引取なのが良い
content:
無料で商品をゲットするには購入しなければなりませんが、ゲーム的なもので植物を育てて無料商品をゲットできるファームランドというのがあります。
その中のファームマージが、キャベツ、スイーツ、苺の3種類をマージして育てますが、キャベツが出るのが極端に少ないので、とてももどかしくてイラッとします。もう少し平均的に出して欲しいです。

購入に関しては、アレルギーがあることがわかったので、試着して肌に合わないものがTEMUからの輸送で注文していれば、無料で返品できたのでとても便利でした。
返品は注文毎に一度目なら無料で佐川急便が引取りに来てくれますので、TEMUの良い点であり、強みはココだと思います。
Amazonや他のショッピングサイトでは返品が出来なかったり、返送料が自己負担で高かったり、合わないと無駄買いになるので不便でしたが、返品ができることが無駄が無く、とても良いです。
カスタマサポートも好対応ですし、チャットで直接対応もして頂けます。
注文から３ヶ月まで返品できますので万が一不具合があっても対応してもらえて助かっています。
また、価格調整で１ヶ月間で値下げした分をTEMUのクレジット(ポイント)に貯蓄できるのも楽しいです♪
安い分、あれ？っと思う商品も多々あり（笑）、賛否両論あるかと思いますが、個人的にはそれも楽しく感じながら利用させて頂いています。

content: I bought an office chair for £75. When I assembled it, I found it was faulty…the whole thing leans over to the side. I contacted customer service to arrange a return and refund. I don’t know how many times I’ve told these people that the chair does not come apart, but they’re either highly incompetent or they’re doing their best to scam me out of £75. I’ll never shop with this joke of a company again.

title: Scammers get your money and then put their store as " not available"
content:
I ordered an orange sofa for $240, and the package was supposedly at a local warehouse in the USA, with a shipping time of 2-6 days. Unfortunately, the item was never shipped, and I had to cancel the order. Although I received a refund, I decided to give Temu another try.

I found another seller offering the same sofa at the same price, with positive reviews, so I placed another order. Unfortunately, the experience was identical. The sofa was allegedly at a local warehouse in the USA, with a shipping time of 2-7 days. It's been 15 days, and the seller hasn't shipped the order. To make matters worse, when I visit the seller's store, it appears as 'unavailable' or 'store not found.' This raises suspicions about whether they're intentionally doing this.

Both stores, COZY HOME RETREAT and MARRIOTT AESTHETICS, disappeared, which suggests they might be engaging in deceptive practices. Given this experience, I'll cancel the order again and refrain from buying a sofa from Temu in the future. I'll spend my money elsewhere. They return the money back to my account as a " temu credit" even thought I asked them to refund my card they didn't. The forced me to buy at temu again even thought I said I dont want a temu credit since im not buying the sofa there again based on my experienced. Now I have to use the money otherwise I will lose it. Here is 1 star for your costumer service. Thank you temu.

content: My mum started using TEMU about 2 years ago & honestly some of the things she’s bought have been a waste of money. The hand tools I’ve bought are top quality. The prices are amazing & I would have no problem recommending ordering from TEMU. Now I think I’ll try & teach my mum how to search properly & compare prices before buying. All in all I’m very pleased

title: Terrible experience with Temu!
content:
Temu is an absolute nightmare. Their app algorithms are downright manipulative, constantly pushing cheap, garbage products at insane prices. You spend hours searching for a decent deal, only for them to suddenly offer the exact same items at a fraction of the price after you’ve already bought them. It’s pure robbery.
And the refunds? Don’t even get me started. They steal ¥2,000–3,000 from your return, claiming it’s for “coupons” or “discounts” that didn’t exist when you ordered. All while claiming that returns are “completely free.” This is blatant fraud and deception.
The algorithms are broken, the app is a trap, and the entire system is designed to screw you over. Using Temu feels like being robbed while smiling at their “helpful” interface. Avoid this company like the plague - it’s a total scam!

title: For all those reading critical reviews
content: I have never had an issue with an order if you ignore the fact that the delivery can sometimes be delayed. As other critical reviews suggest, this app does have some scams on it but so do a lot of apps like these although when this happens it is never directly from tema and is another company selling through temu. I feel like many people who don’t like the app is because their expectations are high and forget that these are shipped from another country so they will sometimes get slightly bashed but all measures to prevent breakage are taken. I recommend trying it to see if it is for you or not which is totally fair as this isn’t the thing for everyone.

title: Well designed shopping application
content:
Temu App Review

Temu is a well-designed and user-friendly shopping app that offers a smooth and enjoyable experience. The interface is clean and intuitive, with bright, high-quality product images that make browsing fun and engaging.

Key Features:

Clear Pricing & Product Display: Prices are easy to understand, with no hidden costs. You can zoom in and out on product images for better detail, and even compare items side by side.
Powerful Search Options: The search functionality is excellent—you can search by name, size, or description, making it easy to find exactly what you’re looking for. The developers have done an impressive job incorporating such a wide range of features.
Fun Extras: The app includes small games that add a light, fun element to the shopping experience—great for lifting your mood.
Customer Service: Customer support is responsive and efficient. Refunds are processed quickly and without unnecessary back-and-forth.
Wide Product Range: There’s a huge selection of items across categories like home goods, clothing, pet supplies, and more.
Easy Payments & Fast Refunds: Payments are hassle-free with options like Apple Pay and Klarna. Refunds are also quick and painless.
Shipping: Standard delivery time is around 3 weeks, which is reasonable considering the variety and low prices.

Overall Impression:

Temu is a surprisingly powerful app packed with useful features, especially for the price-conscious shopper. Between the vast selection, clear pricing, fun extras, and strong customer support, it’s definitely worth trying out.

title: Addictive and good dupes
content: When I first started using Temu I was very skeptical. I have always been a brand name buyer, especially when it comes to food and clothing. I mean how can something be so cheap and also good. Growing up, if it was cheap it was not good quality or taste. My coworkers kept talking about this App and how great it was. They said the products were usually pretty good quality. So I opened my message and clicked on the referral link. It was like Christmas time looking through the Sears catalog! Before I knew it I had a cart full of low priced items. When my packages started arriving I was excited to try them out. It did not disappoint. Some of the items are better than high end merchandise. Only a few times I was not impressed with an item but 99% of the time love them. I buy most of my shirts on Temu. They have everything you can imagine, whatever you need! From clothes to makeup to out buildings and furniture. But don’t get suckered into the “deals” and “prizes”. It will cost you more money than it saves and the free gifts and coupons are split into a lot of fractions and you only get 1 a day(if you buy the minimum requirement) to use.

author: sariiiz

title: Extremely Misleading and Frustrating Experience
content:
Temu is by far the most misleading app I’ve ever used. I was promised free gifts if I invited a certain number of friends (around 7), but even after inviting nearly 20 people, I still couldn’t meet the requirements. Why? Because the points system is intentionally deceptive.

At first, each referral gives a decent amount of points (e.g., 500), but as you get closer to the goal, the value of each new invite drops drastically — to 100, then 50, then 0.5, then 0.025, and eventually down to absurd amounts like 0.001. It becomes a never-ending chase.

It feels like a bait-and-switch tactic to get people to promote the app endlessly without any real intention of delivering the promised rewards. Very disappointed and wouldn’t recommend this app to anyone.

title: クーポンという名の餌で無駄買いさせる
content:
クーポン(使用条件及びやたらと短い有効期間あり)をやたらとばら撒いて「使わないと損」と言うもったいない精神を揺さぶり、非常に品質の悪いものを無駄遣いさせます
中国の企業のサイトのため出品も中国産が多く、品質は非常に悪いです
値段もそこそこ安いですが、正直百均で買った方がまだ品質が良いと思います。
また、支払いが終わってるにもかかわらず、発送できなかったと言う向こうの都合で勝手に返金されます。
用途の目処が付いていたものなども勝手にキャンセル扱いになるのでこちらの都合としては非常に困りました。
悪かろうや、安かろうなものが数多く、良いものは発送されず、勝手にキャンセルになると言う悪質な仕組みです。
ゲーム的な機能もあり、それでクーポンなどを獲得できますが、結局クーポン扱い切れなかったりするので、時間の無駄です。
見た目がかわいいものなども多く載っているのですが、何よりも品質が悪いので非常に残念です。
あと、サポートセンターは最悪です
いつ発送できますか？の質問に対し、ご期待に添えず申し訳ございませんとしか帰ってこなかった。
多分日本人が対応しているのではないと思う。

私は編み物が好きなのでよく毛糸を購入してますが、今のところ失敗なしです。
家電は当たり外れが大きいですが、Amazonでも中華製品ではままあることなので、temuだから失敗した！ということではないかな〜。

title: A welcome surprise amidst rising costs!
content: Like many of you, I was sceptical about buying anything from them after reading so many reviews that painted a negative picture. I installed the app a year ago and during that time I’ve probably purchased over 1000 items, and in all that time only needed to request a refund on 1 damaged item. The app itself is intuitively designed to gamify receipt of discounts, but even the least astute user will quickly recognise the model of gamification used is “everyone’s a winner” - I doubt it would have been as successful 20-30 years ago, but it does hook you, and again to reiterate - I’ve had some amazing deals, spent far too much money, and if you are a fellow ADHDer I hope you have more discipline and self-control than I do! Giving it 5 stars for all round cost-saving, blatant targeting of neurodivergent shoppers, but selling items that have brought moments of hilarity, enabled me to buy bespoke gifts for staff in the office, and I now own a collection of Pixel light sabres for a fraction of the cost. So many sellers are local stockists in the UK, so I’ve even had items arrive within 2 working days - and for those larger items being sent by land, keep an eye on the tracking updates as there’s nothing quite like realising the banjo you’ve purchased has had visited more countries than you have!! In seriousness, set limits on what you’re spending, take advantage of the cash back offers - they really do work as promised, you just need to complete daily logins to complete the rewards in full. Final thought - if you want pristine packaging and levels of presentation that reflect what you might expect from high street store purchases in the UK, then this retailer and app probably isn’t for you!

Giving it 5 stars for all round cost-saving, blatant targeting of neurodivergent shoppers, but selling items that have brought moments of hilarity, enabled me to buy bespoke gifts for staff in the office, and I now own a collection of Pixel light sabres for a fraction of the cost. So many sellers are local stockists in the UK, so I’ve even had items arrive within 2 working days - and for those larger items being sent by land, keep an eye on the tracking updates as there’s nothing quite like realising the banjo you’ve purchased has had visited more countries than you have!! In seriousness, set limits on what you’re spending, take advantage of the cash back offers - they really do work as promised, you just need to complete daily logins to complete the rewards in full. Final thought - if you want pristine packaging and levels of presentation that reflect what you might expect from high street store purchases in the UK, then this retailer and app probably isn’t for you!

国内発送の出品者の商品を注文するときは注意した方がいい。

title: Temu ruined by their choice of courier – Evri
content:
I placed multiple orders with Temu on different dates, it was for an important event. But they irresponsibly shipped everything together in one big parcel via Evri. On 08 August, Evri marked the parcel as “delayed” and promised delivery the next working day – it never arrived, and there has been no update since. At this point, it’s obvious the courier stole it. Partnering with a company notorious for missing and stolen parcels shows Temu puts cost savings over customer satisfaction and trust.

I understand retailers want to keep shipping costs low, but combining multiple orders into one parcel with an unreliable courier is reckless. Temu’s cheap prices mean nothing if your order never shows up – especially when it’s critical for an event. Until they drop Evri and invest in a trustworthy delivery service, I won’t be shopping with them again. Customers should think twice before ordering – Temu’s “savings” could cost you your parcel and a lot of stress.

title: If navigated carefully…
content: So just like anything you got to watch out for scams but if you know what to look out for there are quality products to be bought here for good prices.  It is not Temu’s fault if a seller does somthing shady.  The most common so far I’ve seen is showing a whole lot of extra stuff in the adds that they do not include even though it really looks like it does.   Again, not Temu’s fault but their little Farmland game sorry I have to be honest that is as close to a scam as you can get.  They do Monopoly Go type stuff to make the game almost impossible to win unless…. Yes you guessed it spend a LOT of money.  I got to tell you I am one over 600$ and I’m not even remotely close to getting a couple 5$ free items the game promises.  It is a brilliant little dopamine triggering trap.   Takes advantage of the way our brains like to finish things.  I got to respect the hustle but just know it is a bit like gambling in the aspect that you will sink a ton of cash into it and have nearly zero shot at real success.  Ok rant over.  It is a cool place to go and look at fun stuff to buy.  Watch out for scams but they have a pretty good policy so you should be able to get your money back if you feel you have been taken on a ride.  This is the reason for the 4 stars.

title: 上手く使えば
content:
無料や1円商品をゲットするためには他の商品を数万円分買う必要があります。
知り合いを紹介させて商品を購入してもらうパターンも。
ポイントを貯めるパターンでは残り10%からは1%づつ、残り5%からは0.5%づつしか増えなくなり、いつまで経っても条件が満たせないです。
キャッシュバックも1週間毎日受け取りに行かなければならず、受け取り忘れたらその日のキャッシュバックは受け取れません。
なので割り切って、他のショッピングサイトと比べて安いもの、他では取り扱ってない便利アイテムなどが必要な時に利用しています。
ただ、配送期間が長いので1週間は余裕を持って待つ必要があります。
破損品が送られてきたら、分かりやすく写真を撮って送るだけで5分程度で全額返金、返品不要って事もあります。
到着予定日を超えたら600円ポイントバックもありました。
支払いはカードや銀行口座は利用せず、全てPayPayで利用してますので、今までに何の被害も受けていません。

title: 最低
content:
購入したものやっと届いたと思ったらカビ生えてるしボコボコに潰れてるしあまりにも臭すぎて返品対応してもらい、返品を受け取りに来る宅配業者の時間帯が選べて選び…当日…5〜6時間待っても来ない…業者に電話するとそんな依頼きていないとのこと。
その日1日潰れて、オペレーターとチャットしどうなっているのか聞いてるのに3人くらい人が代わり…1から説明を4回もした。
SHEINは返金対応とか早いのにここはマジダメ。
しかもカビはえてるのにわざわざ返品しないとダメですか？処分じゃダメですか？って言っても頑なに返品しろとのことだった。
写真も送って、状態が悪いのは知ってるのにどうしてそんなにカビがほしいのかなと疑問でした。
そしてその一回でもうやめました。
まだSHINEの方がいい。箱ボコボコとか臭いとかは他でもありますけどカビは初めてでした。
皆さん、広告に騙されないでください。

Highly recommend Temu😃 and Thank you.

title: Senior Citizen & TEMU
content:
I’m one of those Senior Citizens and I admit that I took me a while to learn some of the basics but I have really enjoyed this App Store. I started out buying small inexpensive things so that if I made a mistake on something, it wouldn’t be a “costly “ mistake. Now, I’m furnishing my new renovated bedroom and bathroom with TEMU purchases.
Some of the items are quite big pieces and I’m very happy with everything I’ve bought. The only problem I have, is when they flash information on the screen, it’s so fast that I don’t have time to read it. If I get aggravated, I just click the X on the top of the page and opt out. 😄 Easy Peasy!
One thing that I have discovered, is that TEMU is a great stress reliever for me. I start scrolling through the pages, and I really enjoy seeing all the newest and latest products that have come out. A lot of them I might never have known about. LOL
This is actually my very first Review. I’m 74.

title: Temu Bewertung
content: Ich bin sehr zufrieden mit meinen bisherigen Bestellungen bei Temu. Die Preise sind unschlagbar günstig und das Sortiment ist unglaublich vielfältig – von Kleidung über Haushaltswaren bis hin zu Elektronik-Zubehör ist alles dabei. Die Lieferung dauert zwar etwas länger als bei anderen Shops, aber dafür ist der Versand oft kostenlos und die Ware kommt gut verpackt an. Besonders positiv finde ich, dass man über die App regelmäßig Rabattaktionen und Gutscheine bekommt. Der Kundenservice hat bei einer Rückfrage schnell und unkompliziert geholfen. Für alle, die gern günstig shoppen und kein Problem mit etwas Wartezeit haben, ist Temu definitiv eine Empfehlung!

title: Sells anything and everything.
content: Site is easy to navigate, has a feature to take a picture of a product you are looking for and the app will locate all the sellers on the site selling it. Again I found to copy and paste a product detail in the search also lets you find the best price for a product you have seen listed. Many sellers sell the same product and at varying prices. If you hold product in your basket for a number of days sometimes and offer comes up for just those products. The vouchers are good also and you earn those with purchases. On the whole the site is good, be aware the things shipped by land can take a long time but smaller items and those sold locally are dispatched quickly. The site is updated regularly by Temu but is reliant on the couriers to give accurate information, for the many many purchase I have made the delivery times are realistic and they do give a voucher if they exceed promised delivery time. Customer service are polite but slow and limited on what they can actually assist you with to sort a problem, they basically record detail and generate a “ticket” for their superiors to deal will and this again takes time. It can be very frustrating at time the slow process and if anything I thing this should be improved. This is a very honest review of Temu and if your wondering I would say try it and I think you will be hooked 😄 read produced detail and materials used thoughtfully and will save disappointments.
