title: False Promotions
content:
I’ve been a Temu user for a while since its great for ordering random things at cheap prices. I haven’t had a complaint until I recently experience one of their credit back promos. My uncle has been a longtime user of the promo so he suggested I try it.

The promo is where you initially spend a certain amount ($60 in my case) within an hour an Temu will credit you $60 back in 7 installments. My first order went perfectly. I spent $60 and got $60 back after claiming all 7 installments. In the rules for the promo it clearly states the minimum spending requirement and states that customers can receive and use multiple similar offers.

The next day, I got another offer, but instead of $60 credit back, I would get $50 credit back. Since it still wasn’t bad, I participated in the promo again, but when I had $63 in my cart, the bar at the top of the promo page still said I needed to add another $7 to claim the full credit. When I contacted customer service they told me to follow the notice at the top saying to add another $7 to my cart, which would bring my spending total to $70 instead of $60. Even though in the bar at the top tracking my spending and the rules stated I only needed to add $60+. Customer service could do nothing, but I think something in the programming needs to be fixed or the rules need to be changed because this is clearly false advertising.

title: 最大5,000円分PayPayポイントもらえるは詐欺
content: 最大5,000円分のPayPay ポイントがもらえると聞いて紹介してまわったが、実際はPayPayポイントではなくTemuでしか使えないポイントを一方的に付与されるだけだった。サポートに問い合わせるとPayPayポイントには交換できないと言われた。「PayPay ポイントに交換できるコインを獲得できる紹介リンク」と「Temu専用ポイントに交換できるコインを獲得できる紹介リンク」の2つあるのか？と聞くと「左様でございます」と返信があった。では「PayPayポイントに交換できるコインを獲得できる紹介リンク」はどこで発行できるかと聞いても見違いの返答しか返ってこない。明らかにはぐらかされている。Temuのキャンペーンは詐欺です。また、Temuに電話番号やクレジットカードを登録してはいけません。私はクレカの被害はありませんでしたが、詐欺の連絡や国際電話からの着信は明らかに増えました。また、Temuの取り扱い商品からは発がん性物質の検出が多数報告されています。買うべきではありません。

それと、アプリ内のゲームをして無料商品を貰いたいと頑張っても、なかなか達成しない上に時間がかかる事も分かりました。その間に違った商品を沢山注文して購入している私がいたのも事実です。(笑)
以上です。

title: Mostly Scams
content:
It says on your order tracker that they will give you £4 credit if the package fails to be delivered within the estimated dates.

My package is 2 days past the estimated date, and the option for the £4 credit popped up when I opened the app but then quickly disappeared before I could accept it and the notification was nowhere to be seen.

And if you get price adjustments from your orders that get sent to your credit, they disappear. You can actually see the recordings of the money going into your credit and then being withdrawn even if you haven’t used it. But there is no warning that your credit has to be used within a certain period. They make you think you’re getting money back but you’re really not.

Also, just be patient and wait for those “wheel of fortunes” to finish and press exit. They basically just get you to spend more money by tricking you into thinking your saving.

Every item on Temu is a knock-off and cheap. Which is fine, but don’t fall for the “original prices” and think that you’re getting a huge bargain. You’re getting exactly what you’re paying for - which is a good thing none the less.

Other than these things, everything else on the app is pretty trust worthy. And it is really helpful when you need to upgrade your wardrobe but don’t have enough money.

title: I love temu
content:
Temu is an online marketplace that has rapidly gained popularity due to its competitive prices and a vast array of products. The platform offers everything from electronics and fashion to home goods and beauty products, catering to a wide range of consumer needs.

**Pros:**
- **Affordable Pricing:** One of the standout features of Temu is its incredibly low prices. Many items are significantly cheaper than on other platforms, making it an attractive option for budget-conscious shoppers.
- **Diverse Product Range:** The variety of products available on Temu is impressive. Whether you're looking for the latest gadgets, trendy clothing, or home essentials, you're likely to find it here.
- **Frequent Promotions:** Temu regularly offers discounts, flash sales, and promotional codes, further enhancing the value proposition for shoppers.

**Cons:**
- **Product Quality:** The quality of products can be hit or miss. Since many items are sourced from various manufacturers, there's inconsistency in terms of durability and overall quality.
- **Shipping Times:** Shipping can take longer than expected, particularly for items that are shipped from overseas. This may be frustrating for customers used to faster delivery times from other e-commerce giants.
- **Customer Service:** Some users have reported issues with customer service, including slow response times and difficulties in resolving disputes.

Overall, Temu is a solid option for those looking to save money on a wide range of products. However, potential buyers should be mindful of the trade-offs in quality and shipping times. If you're patient and willing to take a chance on some items, Temu can offer significant savings.

title: No complaints from me.
content: I have now bought over 250 items from Temu and 75% have been 5*. Obviously there are times when “you get what you pay for” comes into play but if I’m paying literally pence for small items I don’t expect them to last a lifetime, even items I have received and realised were not suitable have been perfect for friends and family, so I’ve passed them on. I have only ever had one damaged item, a lovely canvas product which when I informed Temu was immediately refunded and told to keep the product anyway, which with some effort I was actually able to repair and use. I do find their constant emails/ messages a pain and worry that folk who are ‘easily persuaded’ could buy lots of stuff they don’t really need and can’t afford. I personally do not fall into that category!. Being disabled getting out and about isn’t always easy so for me shopping on line has always been a blessing and Temu is my go to place when looking for virtually anything these days.

title: A very disappointing and risky experience
content:
I recently used the Temu app, and I must say, it was a thoroughly disappointing experience. The quality of the products offered on this platform is alarmingly poor. I ordered several items, and almost every one of them failed to meet even basic expectations. The materials were cheap, the items didn’t match the descriptions or images, and some products were downright defective. It’s clear that quality control is not a priority for Temu.

To make matters worse, after using this app, I started receiving scam calls from unknown Chinese numbers. This was alarming and led me to suspect that my personal information had been compromised through the app. It’s highly concerning that a platform like Temu not only sells substandard products but also appears to expose its users to potential security risks.

In summary, I cannot recommend Temu. The poor product quality and the potential risk to your personal information make it a platform to avoid. If you value your privacy and expect a certain standard of quality from online purchases, steer clear of this app.

title: Temu ist in eine Marktlücke gestoßen
content: Wegen der Angebotsvielfalt macht es Spaß durch die Thema-Seiten zu stöbern. Das Preis-Leistungsverhältnis stimmt überwiegend. Auf Reklamationen wird umgehend reagiert und die Preisanpassung mit Rückerstattung ist einzigartig. Was nervt sind die laufenden Animations-Mitteilungen. Sie verleiten zum rabattierten Kauf von Dingen, die man nicht unbedingt braucht. Aber, man muss ja nicht drauf reagieren. Bei Bekleidung sind nur die Baumwolle-Sachen empfehlenswert, die vor Benutzung gewaschen werden sollten. Die Lieferzeiten sind überraschenderweise relativ schnell. Bin gespannt, wie die europäische Konkurrenz auf den chinesischen Anbieter reagieren.

title: App trick you constantly
content:
I’ve been caught out more than once with the app and feel yesterdays order could be my last.  I have purchased quite a few items and most have been fine, but it’s the gifts, coupons & games that con you.  Yesterday I receive a free gift offer and told I had to pick one from the items shown within 30 minutes.  I done this and then it told me I had to purchase, so spent £30 on other items, but when I checked the free gift was not listed.  I contacted customer support and was told I needed to pick the gift and order all within the 30 minutes, but that’s not what you get told.  Then they say it’s a system generated promotion and they can’t do anything.

I was playing some of their games and found that they just do not want to give anything away, but clearly say & show they do.  I played fishland for months and they made it impossible to complete, they done the same with farmland and the hattrick game was a joke.  I needed one person to join Temu to get selected gifts, so a friend said he would join, so I could get the gifts.  Oddly just after he joined, I went to claim my gifts, only to get told this promotion had been removed from our country (UK).

A family member told me to try Shein and they sent a request to me.  I received 4 items I picked for free, because I purchased an t-shirt.  So instantly I got £40 of free items and vouchers for further shops.

I also completed a coupon promotion yesterday and they caught  me out again, I had to spend over £130 to get £30 off, also each coupon had to be used in hours.

title: 中国「拼多多」の海外版
content:
TEMUは、中国の大手オンラインショッピングプラットフォーム「拼多多（Pinduoduo）」の海外版として運営されています。拼多多は、中国国内で非常に人気のあるプラットフォームで、低価格の商品をグループ購入や共同購入の形で提供することが特徴です。このモデルをもとに、TEMUは海外市場向けに展開されています。
注意⚠️
1.	品質のばらつき:
•	TEMUは幅広い商品を低価格で提供していますが、その品質が一貫していないという声があります。一部の商品が期待外れだったり、写真と実物が異なる場合もあります。

2.	配送の遅延:
•	配送が遅れることがあるため、予定よりもかなり遅れて商品が届くケースがあります。特に国際配送の場合、時間がかかることが多いです。

3.	カスタマーサポートの対応:
•	サポートの対応が遅い、または不十分だと感じるユーザーもいます。特に返品や返金の対応に時間がかかる場合があるようです。

4.	誤配送や商品不良:
•	間違った商品が届いたり、不良品が送られてくることも報告されています。これに対する対応がスムーズでないと、トラブルに発展することがあります。

5.	個人情報やセキュリティへの懸念:
•	新興のショッピングプラットフォームであるため、個人情報の管理やセキュリティ面での不安を感じるユーザーもいます。

6.	返品・返金手続きの難しさ:
•	返品や返金の手続きが煩雑で、手間がかかると感じるユーザーもいるようです。特に海外に返品する必要がある場合、費用や時間がかかることが懸念されます。

7.	偽造品の懸念:
•	TEMUで販売されている商品の一部が、正規品ではない可能性があるという指摘もあります。特にブランド品や電子機器に関しては、偽造品のリスクが懸念されることがあります。

これらの点を考慮すると、TEMUでの購入には一定のリスクが伴う可能性があるため、特に高額商品を購入する際には注意が必要です。

title: 不良品を返品させない通販
content:
まず不良品を受け取りました。
早速返品手続きを進めようとしましたがシステムが返品交換依頼はできませんの一点張り。カスタマーサービスのスタッフはどんなジャンルの商品でも不良品なら返品できると案内はするものの実際はさせる気はないようです。
何度問い合わせても"返品依頼をどうぞ"とテンプレ文章を貼る適当な対応で終わり。それができないからこっちは問い合わせてるんだろってイライラします。
またサポートチケットという問い合わせチャットより専門的な問題を取り扱うサービスがあるのですがそこのスタッフが外国人ばかりで日本語を理解できない輩ばかりです。
こちらが指摘している問題を理解せず適当なテンプレ文章を貼り付けて勝手に解決した扱いにし問い合わせを終了させます。もううんざりです。
これから使用を兼用されている方々はご注意ください。困った時に使えないスタッフばかりの通販です。

title: Scam app, not worth the hassle
content:
Temu is a great app for people who don't have a lot of money to buy cheap items, but as with anything that is cheap - it will break and be no good to use within a few uses. Meaning it will end up in landfill.. within a few uses. You're better off paying a bit more for something that will last years rather than months. Again, I understand not everyone has that option, so I am not penalising people for using the app - I have been there and done it.

However, the one thing that is really irritating about this app besides them contributing to mass landfill is the amount of pop ups, ads, emails/notifications and scams that come along with it.

Do not give this app your personal details such as email and phone number to "get discounts" as you will be bombarded with anywhere from 5-10 emails and messages a day, begging you to come back onto the app and use it, or refer friends to earn "money" or spins for games within the app to "win £100s of vouchers". It is all a scam and a pyramid scheme, don't fall for it.

title: App + website seemingly blocked me from accessing website while shopping.
content:
Like the title says, I was trying out TEMU for the very first time and trying to get as many low price/about to be sold out items I liked as possible since I had a coupon that, if I read things right, would make any items under $10 free once I had $40 worth of items. However, as I was shopping over the span of many hours, I kept getting asked to do verification checks where you slide a puzzle piece into place. At first I was passing them, but then the website started to fail me even if the piece was perfectly in place or inconsistently failing/passing me if it was off to one side a little. Then it introduced penguin shaped puzzle pieces, which I messed up on a few more times.

I went to the app after I first started noticing the issue (not being able to see or access anything), failed a few more puzzle tests before completing one, then realized I couldn’t access anything on there either. Now I’m debating on what to do because I can see people are rating items on the website (i.e. not a website problem) and I can still edit things on my cart window, but I literally cannot access anything else other than the homepage. I can see items on the website if I go into incognito mode on my computer, but logging in causes the error page, implying TEMU intentionally blocked my IP address from using their website after intentionally failing what were correctly done anti-bot tests…

What’s the point of marketing yourself as being a place to get a bunch of cheap stuff with a coupon if you won’t let me use your website to do that? I feel scammed out of my time.

title: 良く利用してます
content:
雑貨や服、猫グッズを安く買えるので良く利用してます。シーリングスタンプグッズを安く買えたのがとても嬉しいです。
メルカリだと高いので今まで手が出せなかったのですが、ようやく趣味を始める事が出来ました。
写真の色合いは違う事がありますが、それはもう仕方ないですね。
冬物で大きな毛布を購入しましたが凄い技術で圧縮されて小さく届きました。
軽くて暖かくて気に入りました。暖房を使わなくても暖かく眠れるので重宝します。
今月大きなキャットタワーを購入した時に壊れて届きましたが、すぐに返品、返金処理してくれたので良かったです。
キャットタワーが手に入らなかったのは残念でしたが、対応はとても早いです。
そして海外から来るのに届くのが早いです。
離島に住んでますが、発送から約1週間で届きます。助かります。

追記: 約11ヶ月利用しています。
毎月何かしら購入してますが購入した商品のうち1/3は微妙だったりダメなものでしたが2/3は良い、とても良い商品です。
ただモヤモヤする事が一点。レビューです。
商品のレビューを事細かに丁寧に書いてもその商品が製造停止や出品停止になると書いたレビューも無駄になります。誰にも読まれる事のないレビューを私は真面目に書いていたのかと、、、ダメだった（壊れてたり）商品の悪い評価を書くとすぐに商品ページが無くなります。悪い評価を残さない為でしょうか。
レビューもあまり信用できませんね。
悪い評価するよりその都度返金してもらう方が賢そうです。
ネックレスなんて特に酷いものでしたよ。錆びてましたし、飾りが抜け落ちてるのもありました。安くてもこれじゃあ意味がありませんね。
アクセサリーを買うのはやめました。
このレビューは消されない事を祈ります。

猫の寝床やスローフィーダー皿（早食い防止皿）などはとても良かったです。
猫は吐き戻しが多い動物で寝床もよく汚すので年に1回、2回買い替えられる安さはとても助かります。
市販の約半額〜1/3の値段で買えました。
良いもの悪いものを見極めて買い物を楽しむと良いと思います。

title: It’s a 50/50.
content: Whenever I try and help my friends with getting free things, it takes me to a “get 1 thing free” so I do that. Then it’s like “it’s your lucky day” and it “doubles” how many free things I could get. Then it says “special reward!” And it adds 4 more things I could get for free. But eventually it takes forever to get the last $0.5. Then I’m down to $0.2. Then I can’t even do anything else because I keep getting the message “you’re almost there! So many other people have won 6 free things! Keep going!” But I can’t even get the last $0.2 to be able to get the free things. Honestly, “getting stuff for free” on temu is just a scam. The low prices when I’m actually buying things, are good, but when it says I can “get stuff for free”? No. It’s just lying. Overall, I mostly like temu when I don’t have to deal with “invite friends to get this for free!”. I’m glad though when I actually spend money and it’s the thing that I wanted.

title: やってくれるわ
content:
コイツの広告で出てくる商品、使い勝手も良さそうで、安いし買っちゃえ！！ってなる前にまず、コイツ
日本の金を使って送料無料でベッコベコの箱と共にゴミを送りつけてくるアプリです。まぁもっと酷いものもあれば、ある程度ば使えるものもありますが、まぁピンキリです。
コイツ、品数だけはいいんですよ。まぁAmazonや楽天ショッピングには劣りますが…その中でもmade in chineが97%くらいです。
まぁ中国だから悪いというわけではないのですが、まぁあまり良い印象は持てませんよね。
その通りです。まず、コイツで売っているものがこんなに安くて低品質なわけとして、より安いものしかtemuは表示しないので工場というか企業間で、価格競争の嵐が巻き起こっているわけです。もちろん作る方の会社は表示されなくなると売り上げがなくなるので、どんどん価格を下げていって生産コストもそれに合わせてどんどん削られていくので良い材料も使えずに品質の悪いガラクタしか売れなくなるわけです。流石にフタル酸系可塑剤を子供用品に入れるのはちょっと…とは思いますけどね。あ、フタル酸系可塑剤の影響はおそらくwikiになっているのでぜひ。
話を戻すとまぁ人によってはガラクタないのかもしれませんが、私が購入した物の中で使えるものといえば商品の梱包材くらいですかね。(笑)
別にダウンロードを止めるつもりはないのですが、こういうアプリにクレカ情報、住所その他諸々を入力するということを考えてからダウンロードしてください。

title: Erstaunlich gut
content:
Temu ist wie ich bisher feststellen konnte ein solider, ehrlicher Onlineshop. Die Qualität der Ware ist genauso gut wie bei anderen Onlineshops . Auch die Lieferung war bisher immer pünktlich!
Ich bin wirklich erstaunt und auch entsetzt, wie wir hier betrogen werden! Fakt ist, dass der Chef von Amazon der reichste der Welt ist! Ich weiß jetzt warum! Ich werde, wenn möglich und der Artikel verfügbar ist, unter anderem bei Temu bestellen  und nicht mehr in deutschen Shops. Leider ist das die wahre Realität! Temu ist ein ehrlicher, unkomplizierter Shop in dem man alles mögliche findet und günstig kaufen kann.

title: 安物買いの銭失いになりかねない
content: 確かに格安ですが、しばしば後悔する事ママあります。商品説明が不親切極まりなくまるで誤解させて、格安品を買わせようとしてるかの様な姿勢を感じます。例えば電機商品を買おうかと思いキーワード検索すれば多数ヒットしますが、商品説明をよく読むと、商品本体ではなくて付属品の様な印象受けることが有り、商品トップ写真だけで判断すると、誤って付属品を購入してしまうミスをしそうでした。付属品を出品なら、付属品だけの写真を載せるべきなのにあたかも本体の販売かの様に見せかけて格安を印象づける。特に電気製品の場合、電源が入らないなどの不具合も珍しくないのに、返品方法の説明も分かりにくい。カスタマーセンター等の問い合わせ窓口でも有れば良いけどそれも無い。

Developers/managers must hear the message - make coupons usable for longer period, stick to what you say on delivery and make prices actually better if it takes longer to deliver!

title: 商品の扱いが雑
content:
梱包が雑で丸められてグシャグシャで袋詰めされてシワだらけでした。それはある程度許容範囲ですが、
中には裏にひっくり返った物も何点かあり驚きました。
特に靴下やボクサーパンツ、ショーツなどの下着類がひっくり返ってシワだらけだと衛生面で不安を感じます。

普段はS‥と言う類似のショップを利用してますが、TEMUの方が品揃えがいい印象なので、送料無料の2100円越えて注文する商品があれば、たまに利用してますが、S‥の方が丁寧です。

ルーレットやカードなどの通知が多すぎてウザいです。１日に何通も届きます。
ルーレットやゲームによる値引きやクーポンなどは胡散臭いので利用しません。 世の中おいしい話は何らかの罠があり、安く思わせて結局何らかの商品の追加を‥と言うような戦略かと感じてしまいます。
実際に利用したことがないので真相はわかりません。色んな物を購入したい人にはいいかと思いますが、欲しい商品だけしか買わない者には不要なサービスです。

S‥と言うショップみたいに定期的に低額注文でも送料無料サービスデーやクーポンを配布してくれる方がいいです。
どうしてもTEMUで欲しい商品があれば利用するかもしれせん。

商品の扱いが雑だし、2100円以上でないと購入ですらできないので、使いにくいので残念です。 少額でも送料負担すれば買えるようにして欲しいです。

title: I really tried!
content: I never had any issues with them charging me for things I didn’t order, my bank account was never messed with, but I am deleting my Temu account. There are other apps with better rewards that you can actually get without having to invite loads of people. It is weird to me that Temu seems to reward invites more than what you spend in their app, I guess that is a red flag itself. You are far less likely to get any ‘free’ items if you don’t burden your friends with invites (and even if you do, it only counts if they click the link and sign up for Temu). I can’t say for sure how much you have to spend to get things in farmland or fish land because I spent hundreds and still didn’t have enough rewards to finish either. Temu did offer me a 20% off coupon and then a $5 credit for my troubles, but when I declined both and said I just wanted them to be honest about the changes in what your feeding or watering is worth as you progress, they said Temu has rules and they hope I understand. Well, I don’t understand. I just said to be honest and you’re saying you can’t. I appreciate the honesty about the lying, but it’s time I delete my account.

title: Honest Temu review:
content: My first month on Temu and I have formed a love hate relationship with this company. I love that you can find almost anything you want for any occasion or any season. All the while knowing that your product is going. To be made light and as inexpensive as possible, that’s the only way they can offer the things they do for the price they have. That being said: I have found that the description of the items is more of a fairy tail than a statistic of these products. Mostly the jewelry. I have ordered tem pieces of jewelry that claim to be sterling silver and silver they are not. The necklaces with pendants that are supposed to be silver are only held on the stainless steel chain with a tiny crimp clasp that is marked s925. The big diamond necklaces that range from $12-$280 Iced out are one and the same necklace all three that I ordered. No stamp nor hallmark. The endoscope was true and so was the tiny cameras, I just received my first of three drones which have been stuck over in customs for a week but I haven’t had a chance to get it out yet. Shop at your own risk. Just know they don’t want your complaints. If you don’t like it return it 100 of the time so that’s good I guess. Hope that helps someone

title: Hervorragender Service und gute Qualität
content:
Die Fülle der Angebote bei Temu mag einen zunächst erschlagen. Dafür gibt es aber sehr gute Filterfunktionen.
Mir gefällt sehr, dass auf unnötige Umverpackungen verzichtet wird, die lediglich Marketing-Zwecken dienen und dann doch nur entsorgt werden müssen.
Meist liegen auch keine Anleitungen bei; die jeweilige Anleitung befindet sich dann in kleinen Videos direkt in der Artikelbeschreibung. Auch das finde ich umweltfreundlicher, als jedes Mal kleine Heftchen auszudrucken und zu versenden, wenn sie anschließend doch nur im Mülleimer landen.
Wenn man die Bewertungen beachtet, die andere KundInnen verfasst haben, kann man sehr treffsicher sehr gute Qualität zu sehr kleinen Preisen erhalten. Dabei habe ich in den letzten Monaten Haushalts-Produkte, Material für Renovierungsarbeiten, Papierwaren fürs Büro sowie Kleidung, Schuhe, Möbel und Bettwäsche bestellt.
Die Kommunikation von Temu rund um den gesamten Versandprozess ist hervorragend und transparent.
Das Reklamationsmanagement ist einzigartig: Verspätet sich Ware auch nur um einen einzigen Tag, erhält man umgehend fünf Euro Entschädigung ausgezahlt. Ich bin absolut begeistert und sehe nicht mehr ein, für gleichwertige Produkte das Fünf- bis Zehnfache hinzulegen.

title: Website
content:
Sometimes this site is very confusing. Looks there are separate stores and a main “store”,  each offering different minimums for credits or shipping. Be careful as you may order something twice as the checkout is confusing on this, especially when they say  you need to order x amount more to get or how you’re checking out. ( adding to order after checkout for example). Many of the same items in each with different prices. This needs to be differentiated better. Temu is awesome with returns or credits though. I do find searching for my orders,  for example doing reviews very hard to find. Sometimes I need to refer back to an item for instructions, because they don’t include basic instructions or even the name of the item (or a scannable code)to look it up. Lack of instructions is on the manufacturers though. (They also need better descriptions as to type of fabrics used in clothing..You Never know what it’s going to be). Shipping times seems to have improved,  and they issue the $5 shipping credit automatically if it’s late.

So, make your website easier and less confusing but keep up the good work otherwise.

title: Shopping Apps Shouldn't Have Pop Ups
content:
The 3 sins of Temu:

Everytime I open Temu it bombards me with "spin the wheel" "win free item". Every. Single. Time. Even after checkout it's always "spin this wheel" "view 3 items for points" "tap here to win"

In order to buy anything you have to spend a certain amount, there's a minimum and it's never below £10. You have to spend £10 in order to buy anything from Temu. Often I'm only looking to buy one thing, often meaning I end up with several items I don't want just so that I can get my one item.

Images and even descriptions are never accurate to the real product. Just to give one example (although this is not the only story I've got) I bought a shirt from Temu once and when it arrived it came in a size too small, so I thought it was my own error and I must have read the charts wrong, so I bought the same shirt a size larger. The new shirt arrived and it was the same size as the previous one. I'm genuinely under the impression that the sizes you can select are a front, and they only have the one size in their storage, assuming it will fit everyone and no one will notice.

title: Every recommendation leads to really happy customers
content:
I have been using Temu for about a year now and whenever the opportunity comes up for me to share with someone unfamiliar with Temu my experiences using it- it’s always resulted in that individual sharing their positive experiences with Temu.
I feel that Temu is one of the most satisfying experiences when it comes to getting products that are of equal quality or sometimes better quality than the products offered in the box stores; at prices that are half what they are and sometimes the savings are even greater. I have had conversations with people wondering how Temu is able to sell products at such lower prices than the prices that you would come to expect in stores and my answer is that they cut out nearly all of the “middle men”- no distributors costs which tend to be significant and seem to be only increasing evermore.
Anyone reading this that has not tried out Temu - I say go for it and see what you can find at much lower prices than what you typically are used to.

title: Excellent value for most items bought.
content:
Almost everything I’ve bought from Temu has been great value. I have marked them 4 / 5 stars due to the fact that their packaging leaves a lot to be desired.
A hat I bought, delivered in a plastic bag, was crushed beyond repair; the pointed heels of shoes, also in a plastic bag, had poked through and been damaged themselves, got thoroughly soaked along with everything else in that order and also damaged some of the other items in the bag; a metal sign arrived bent out of shape.
Temu were very understanding and helpful with arranging quick returns/replacement or just refunding. I would much rather they packed everything in boxes!
The only clothing I’ve bought is swimwear and for those items, I would impress upon everyone to buy a size or two larger than usual. Clothes & swimwear can be taken in, but generally (these days especially) cannot be let out!
Overall, extremely pleased with most of my purchases.

title: Not nearly as good as AliExpress
content: If I hadn’t had AliExpress first I would probably rate this higher but the problems with this app don’t stand up to comparison. There are way too many pop ups and the app itself is way harder to navigate. The coupons and free gifts are extremely deceptive. Many times it won’t even allow you to just exit out of the pop ups or free gifts pages. The shopping cart is also deceptive. It doesn’t aggregate the different products that have different deals. You have to buy the items from the deal page directly or you lose the deal. The low prices are nice, but I can get the same deals at AliExpress without spending more money than I intended just to get coupons or a free gift. I can’t put things in a wish list for looking at later. The whole purpose of this shopping app is to force you to make many small purchases in order to get a good deal and it constantly says that the deal is expiring to get you to buy in a hurry so you don’t have time to think about how much you are spending. There are many things that say you get a deal but there is no clear cut shopping cart for the deals when you hit the purchase button so things end up being more expensive than you thought. There’s nothing illegal done, just a lot of unethical shortcuts to the app. The only part of this site that is better than AliExpress would be that more products come from the states, so the shipping is faster. If you can navigate through the deals and the app well enough it might work out for you but I don’t want to have to think so hard when I’m just shopping for something. I shop to relax not to match wits with the developer.

title: It can be great! Just be cautious.
content: My dad recommended me this app a while back, and while I was skeptical at first, he told me that he actually got some fine deals off of it. I tried it myself, and hey, he was right, it's not entirely a scam! However, be careful–some items may be faulty, and Temu may try to use tactics to get you to spend more than you initally planned. My advice is to treat it like you would any other shopping app instead of falling for the allure of "one-time offers" and "free items" and the like, as well as making sure to check the reviews of an item and the group selling it before you really consider buying said item. And, of course, use common sense: If you see a really powerful computer that costs, like, $2 on there, you're probably not actually going to get a really powerful computer when you pay for it. With all of that said, however, I should probably restate that, again, you can definitely get some excellent deals through this app! Like, I got most of my clothes for my MtF transition out of the app, and what would've costed me hundreds of dollars from other stores only cost me about $60 here!... Just be careful.

title: Inflation Buster!
content:
As a Dollar Store junkie, I know how to pick out an inexpensive quality item among cheap waste-of-money junk. Almost all of the many items I’ve purchased from this company have been exactly what I needed and wanted. Tracking and shipping were seamless. Had one return and customer service couldn’t have been better! The more you shop, the more surprised you’ll be to get so much for so little.
I wrote this review over a year ago and here’s my update. The longer I shop with Temu, it’s been mine and my friends experience that the quality of items decrease substantially. Customer service that was so excellent in the beginning no longer is. Items I have ordered in the past at the same price, for example shoe insoles, that were a thick rubber material are now, upon reorder, made of flimsy cardboard. I can site many more examples of decreasing quality and rising prices. Yet new Temu shoppers get the prices and quality I used to receive. In addition, the constant notification ads, emails, games and spinning roulette wheels are overwhelming. It’s all turned me away from Temu.

title: 調査してみました
content:
まずは良く見る広告の99円のフラッシュセール

サポートに問い合わせ、在庫少数で事実上購入不可ってことはないよね？と牽制したところ

「在庫少数といった悪質な広告ではありません」

との言質を取りましたが、実際には売り切れとなり購入できませんでした。

サポートの返答も「抽選」とずっと言い続けており、途中で「抽選なんですか？」と指摘したところ「先着順です」と言い直してました。

広告では「大当たり」「アプリで入手」「購入」などの表示がされますが、実際には購入できません。

無料商品だのクーポンだのと謳っていますが、新規ユーザーを紹介しないと受け取れません。

基本的に内容は全て虚偽だと考えましょう。
個人情報なんて今時あちこちに流出しているので気にするだけ無駄ですが、広告やキャンペーンに期待して利用しようと考えている方にはお勧め致しません。

title: They expect too much for their freebies
content: It’s not a bad app in terms of low prices for good items but when it comes to getting anything free they expect way too much or rather they don’t give you enough “credit” for the invites you send. You HAVE to invite people who don’t have temu to get any decent credits towards your freebies but considering the amount of people who actually use temu I don’t understand why or how they can expect you to be able to invite someone who has never used temu before. And when you do invite existing users they barely give you any kind of credit for them accepting your invites. On top of you only have 24 hours for them to accept the invite and if they’ve already accepted from another friend you don’t get any credit for it. I truly feel like their system for getting anything free is flawed extremely!!! Would be nice to not have wasted my time the way I have trying to get even a couple of items free. I’ve given up on ever actually being able to get any kind of freebies because it’s not worth the trouble of sending all the invites they expect you to send. You’re better off just buying it in all honesty

content: アプリを開くと無料で何品か獲得と出る。無料なのかと喜ぶのも束の間、お魚パクパクとかファームとかのゲーム内のゲージを100%にしないと無料にならない。よって実質無料ではない詐欺みたいなことをしてる。紹介しろとか買い物したらポイント還元とかゲージポイントやを買えとか意味が不明。もう半月はゲームクリア目指してやってみたが99%までは割といくがあとの1%が0.001位の刻みで上がるから到底100%に辿り着けない。要するにネズミ講みたいなもの。何人か紹介したがこのアプリはダメやからと随分叱られている。実際時計を買っておもちゃみたいな時計がぼろぼろの梱包で届いたと紹介した人に怒られた。あとカード使ったら詐欺電話がかかり出してきた。なんかカード情報ダダ漏れです。慌ててカードを作り直した。PayPay払いが安全です。お気をつけて下さい。ゲームで詐欺みたいな事をしなければ良いアプリとも思えますが危険なアプリかと思います。友達減らしたい方は紹介してみてください。

title: Amazing prices and amazingly bad products
content: First of all, I’m the first person to agree that prices on this app are amazing, and the offers and deals are also pretty insane. However, the products on here are SHOCKINGLY BAD. I placed two orders so far (10 items in total), six of which are either completely unfit for purpose from the get go, or started malfunctioning after just a couple of weeks. These include wall lights that are way too sensitive and constantly fall off, an electric wine bottle opener that doesn’t go deeper than 2cm into the bottle (let alone removing the cork), socks that had holes in them after two wearings, and phone screen protectors that form air bubbles as a result of me using the screen!!! Credit where it’s due, the return process is pretty straightforward. But be warned - shopping here is like buying lottery, you have no idea whether you’ll get something useable . GOD ONLY KNOWS where all the raving reviews on these items came from. Lastly, as a user of PDD (the company’s sister app in China) which has genuinely good quality and good value items, I’m utterly bewildered at the complete absence of quality control of the items they choose to sell on temu. All the bargains in the world would not tempt me to use them again.

content:
ファームランドや、お魚パクパクなどゲームをさせたり、友人を招待して『商品を無料ゲット』と謳いポップアップが出てきて、顧客を増やそうとするが、結局私の場合それに踊らされ『あと30円で無料ゲット、友達を招待してください』と言う文句で友人を招待するも、『あと10円で、無料ゲット！友人を招待してください』と出てきて結局どうにもこうにも(笑)

title: Watch Your Wallet
content:
Although I’ve enjoyed this app for the most part, I noticed a few details that have me shaking my head. For example: each time my total purchases add up to be enough so the items can be shipped free, I see that the “Total Amount at Checkout” has increased so that I now need to add a few more items to get the Free Ship benefit back.
I know there are other sneaky ways TEMU manages to get customers to grab up more deals - it’s as if there are deals upon deals upon deals - and some actually ARE Very Good deals, but before you know it you have spent 3x as much as you orig. planned.
I noticed my TEMU purchases on my CC statement were multiplying (instead of just 2 expected purchase totals, now there are 5 or 6) before I knew how or why. This app is so easy & fun to use that you sort of can’t help yourself, so please be advised that it might be wise to set an alarm so you don’t wind up shopping half the day away (& spending God knows how much) before you know what happened.
So ‘Buyer Beware’, put that phone down before you wind up buying a ton of goodies you really didn’t need but now you must pay for.
I’m just saying guys ~ watch out!!😉

title: 真相をまじめに書きます
content:
色々と使って見ての感想にプラスして、ネットでのウワサ、ブロガーの記事、YouTuber達の使って見た　以上を更に見てきて、そして継続して使っている視点での感想です。ご参考に──

Q.怪しいんでないの？
A.不安な人はクレカ以外の支払いが選択できます。主はApple Pay挟んで支払ってます。クレカでは細かく明細をいつも見てますが、不正な支払いはないです。

P.S.安すぎる・梱包が雑いといった、日本からの考えではありえないためにどうしても怪しいと思えてしまうのは至極当然ですね。

Q.なんで主は使うの？
A.家電系はおすすめしません。ガジェット系ですね。中身の容量や電子部品なんかは、解体や接続しないと見えないですから。そこはパチモンが多いです。では何故使うのかというと、ちょっとした猫ミームのぬいぐるみや、ちょっとあれば便利なアイテム(DAISOではあるようでないような物)は使えます。『変わったもの』『ネタ』『気分転換グッズ、ファッション』というイメージです。

Q.使っていて困ったことは？
A.Temuはテム内でとにかく完結させたい傲慢な欲求がとにかく強い（苦笑）　なので、まあ通知でセールやアプリ開いて〜が多いです。これはまずOFFにしましょう。バッテリーをバックグラウンドで食うだけです。あと、価格はしょっちゅうすぐ安くなるので、「もうすぐ売り切れです」とかは基本無視OK。一番困った点は、スマホのバッテリーを消費することです。先ほどのように通知OFF、バックグラウンド通信系を切ってしまえば、開いている時以外は干渉しません。ただ、開いて閲覧している分には普通の消費ですが、以下強調──!
“Temu内にあるゲームを遊ぶと熱を食う”です！！
何それという方に簡単に説明すると、Temuにはざっくり２種類ゲームがあります。お魚パクパクとファームです。このゲームはそれぞれひたすら作業系のそこいらのゲームアプリと同様のしょぼいゲームです。何故あるのかというと、これを進行させてクリアすれば無料で好きに選択した商品を貰えます(これは実際に貰えました）。ただ、TikTokやYahoo!知恵袋にもアンサーにあるように、これがまたケチ臭くイケズで、クリアが近くなるにつれよりシビアにゴールを遠のくように設定されてます。これがうんざりしてゲームを辞める人も多いでしょう。ようは、暇つぶし程度のもので、人との待ち合わせや電車内での隙間時間に進行させる程度のゲームと思えば気楽ですし、ストレスフリー。ただ、これが馬鹿デカくバッテリー消費するから気をつけてねーということです。

Q.商品て本当に届くの？壊れてない？
A.梱包がダンボールでなく、鼠色の袋に入れてあるだけなので、雑いです。それの所為も相まって、開封して既に壊れている・破れている・割れているといった不良品もたまーにあります。価格が安すぎるので、そういったクオリティと初めから理解して利用してやりましょう。靴やズボンは皮やジーンズでなくゴムが多いです。会社の人に見せたら「何か変わってませんそれ!?」といろんな人に突っ込まれます（笑）

Q.不良品が届いたり、納得しない物は返品返金できるの？
A.シンプルにできます。こっちからコンビニに行くわけでなく、佐川さんやヤマトさんとTemuは契約しているので、Temuが返品返金までの流れをわかりやすい画面で案内します。3ステップくらい。ダンボールに商品とその商品の袋に貼られてるバーコードも一緒に梱包→配達員さんを好きな日程と時間指定→取りに来られ渡すと完了→個人差ありますがすぐに返金されます。
※注意点として、コンビニ支払いだと現金返金は原理的にされないため、Temu内にあるTemuクレジット(ようはポイントのようなもの)にして変換されます。

以上を参考になれば幸いです。

title: Too easy to buy something you don’t want and too hard to fix it
content: Temu makes it easy to buy but very difficult to correct mistakes. If you’ve just made a purchase, you have a chance to add other items to your order at a deep discount. If you click on an item to get more details, it’s added to your order and your card is charged. You’ll have to request a refund. If you add an item to your cart and remove it, you may have to remove it several times. There’s a Buy Now button that’s very easy to accidentally press. Your card is immediately charged and you’ll have to request a refund. There aren’t enough purchase confirmation steps which I believe is by design. I’ve deleted all my payment information from the app hoping I don’t make any more unintentional purchases. There’s no chance to really cancel anything. Also, your shipment may be incomplete which I think is also by design. You have to provide the package information and since they usually ship an order in multiple shipments, you may have discarded those packages before you realize you didn’t receive something. Yes I’ve found some good prices but I have to be very careful when using the app. I’m constantly checking my cart to delete things I didn’t want and checking my order history to make sure I didn’t pay for something I didn’t want. Every time, I’ve found something I didn’t want and since I don’t have this issue on other apps, I believe it’s them and I believe it’s intentional. If they can sneak in a few unintentional purchases and make the refund process difficult, they can make more money.

title: Eigentlich ganz gut, aber….
content:
Die fast komplette von mir bestellte Ware war bis jetzt in sehr gutem Zustand und guter Qualität. Wie bei anderen Onlinehändlern (wie z.B. Amazon) greift man auch hier aufgrund übermotivierter Werbung mal ins Klo. Dafür kann die Plattform eher weniger was. Schaue aber immer gern rein.

Schade…

title: Disappointed with "Local Warehouse" Shipping Restrictions
content:
I’ve been a frequent TEMU user for quite some time, but the recent introduction of the “Local Warehouse” option has significantly impacted my shopping experience in a negative way. The requirement to meet a $30 threshold from each specific local warehouse to get free shipping is very frustrating. Often, these local warehouses carry very niche products, making it difficult to find $30 worth of items I actually need from one specific warehouse.

What makes it worse is the inability to filter out items from local warehouses. I would prefer to shop for items that are shipped directly from TEMU rather than navigating through the convoluted local warehouse system. Alternatively, TEMU should allow free shipping for orders totaling $30 from multiple local warehouses combined. This would make the shopping experience much more flexible and convenient.

As it stands, these changes have made the TEMU shipping experience less convenient and user-friendly. I find myself buying less and less from TEMU because of these restrictive and inconvenient shipping policies. I hope TEMU reconsiders these policies to restore the ease and convenience that once made shopping here enjoyable.

title: Not only fun but good value
content: I tried Temu with a little apprehension of a low price on-line shop that I had never come across before, but via FaceBook there was an item that caught my eye. I was so please with price,delivery and quality of the item, I placed another order for some of the household gadgets that I call ‘Try Out’ prices. Their choice for creative and hobby items, kitchen and household ideas seem endless. However it is the good delivery promise ( the date was only missed once) and the speed and honoring of their ‘compensation’ policy that was perfect. I have only had to contact Temu about one defective item and the reply contact and credit cost was dealt with in less than 36 hours. I have only lost money on one delivery which was through a delivery company that I researched and found to be suspect. Unfortunately I could not get a response from Temu on that occasion and lost the 13 euro payment. On the whole though it is a varied site to scan through and find some ‘ fun treats’ .

title: Scam all around
content:
I have ordered quite a few items and the majority of them were either extremely small (and did not match the measurements provided in the description) or were very low quality. Then there’s the games where you can “win” free stuff. What a joke. I invited numerous people, some of whom were new users, received the notification that they had clicked on my link and had it credited towards my end goal until I reached the last penny needed. Then it froze. No matter how many people clicked my link, none of them were credited as that last cent. And then I realized none of the people I invited, including the ones who I was credited for, showed up in the invitations tab. So I contacted customer support. I have never been blamed so thoroughly by a company and been told that I “just need to invite more people”. Some how it was twisted around that yes I did invite people but I had “met my daily limit” and at the same time I “hadn’t invited anyone”. I was offered a 20% off of an order coupon “for the inconvenience”.
All I have to say now is that I will not be giving them my business and Shein has much better quality items (and the shipping is faster as well).

title: Ok.. could be better
content:
You can find anything and everything on Temu. The thing is, it is not going to of top notch quality. Items are rather cheap in both aspects. Some items I’ve gotten have been great. But a lot of others have been terrible. My packages always arrive damaged and it’s not uncommon to receive wrong items or sizes or not receive all items ordered. But Temu has been great about refunds and return for all orders that weren’t correct or came damaged or defective.

There are opportunities to run free items. You just have to go through hoops. If you know a lot of people that don’t already have Temu then you should be able to take advantage of and benefit from the free gift tasks. There are also always promos. Some are good and some not so much. The rules are not ever defined before you accept the promo. Also, you do get coupons but they’re never really worth it anymore. When I first started purchasing from Temu the coupons and the promos were great. Either it was only for new customers or they’ve made a lot of changes and it’s affected customer rewards.
There are games inside Temu that you can play to earn free items. But don’t think it will be easy or a quick process. It is at first until you get to .05 cents give or take a FEW cents. Then it seems nearly impossible to complete the requirements.
I am on Temu a lot just looking at stuff. I do find it interesting all of the items they have. I’ve made several purchases and I’ve only received a mascara for free. So it’s not as advertised.

title: Temu review
content:
When I began inquiring about Temu from people who have used it, I felt somewhat nervous about making a purchase. Many individuals would compare it to Wish, which is a well-known online marketplace. However, as a previous Wish user, I find that Temusurpasses it in several aspects.
Firstly, the delivery time for products on Wishtends to have a wide range, making it unpredictable. In contrast, Temu consistently delivers products in a timely manner, which I appreciate.
Secondly, and perhaps more importantly, Temu offers higher quality products. While I’ve encountered only one item from Temu that didn’t meet my performance expectations, I attribute it to a potential machining error rather than a lack of overall quality. Overall, my experience with Temu has been positive, and I intend to continue purchasing from them in the foreseeable future.
Thank you, Temu, for providing a reliable and quality shopping experience! 🛒🌟

title: 無料云々は全て嘘、品質は値段相応
content:
無料で商品を貰えるという系は、全てLINEで〇〇人紹介やポイント使ってゲームをクリアするとなっており、一見簡単に何万円分の商品を貰えそうですが、紹介系は何人か紹介するとさらに人を紹介しろとなり、ゲーム系も使用するポイントを、人を紹介、又は、商品を購入するとポイントを貰えるとなっていますが、使用するポイントに対しての効果がドンドン少なくなるので、永遠にクリアできません。
ポイントの為に商品を購入するより、ゲームをクリアして無料で貰える商品を、直接買った方が効率的です。(このゲームも謎に時間を掛けさせる仕様になっています)
また、タイトルにも書いている様に、苦労して手に入れた無料の商品も、値段なりなので、オモチャの様な出来や不良品が送られてくる可能性が高いです。
商品の中には、コスパはいいものもある事は確かですが、嘘だらけのキャンペーン通知の嵐、個人情報漏洩のリスクを考えるとオススメは出来ません。
商品の購入は、不良品や壊れたものが届いても当たり前ぐらいに期待せず購入する方が良いです。
届いて、品質の良いものが来たらラッキー程度で。(幾つか商品購入、ゲーム等した感想)

title: I like Temu, BUT…
content: Temu sends photos of their ads to my Apple photo gallery without my knowledge or permission. Why? They just take up unnecessary space on my devices and cause them to run slow. I deleted the app for two weeks and my Apple devices stopped acting crazy. As soon as I added the app back on my iPhone, the phone started acting crazy again. Also, Temu relies heavily on REVIEWS of each item you purchase. The app seems to be more user friendly when you write good reviews (they actually give you words to describe the items lol) and it’s very easy to write a review or just send stars. I gave Temu 3 stars because I don’t like their games. They seem to be designed to keep you spending money, hoping that you will get hooked because they don’t plan to ever allow you to win. That’s craziness. The only reason why I downloaded this app again is because they really have some great items and will refund once time for each other when necessary. If you don’t want an item you just purchased, they will give you a refund before the item ships. They give you about 4 hours to “add on” to an order you have just placed. Long 2 weeks waiting for delivery is to be expected, but the app has an excellent tracking system.

title: Decent ( makes you jump through hoops )
content: The products are typically “decent” and for a low price. Temu offers you “free” or “play to win” products with a headline like pick 6 free. Just know that it is very difficult ( near impossible ) to get these products. It is usually earned through referring new users and / or earning credits of some sort. Just know the closer you get to your credit goal to earn your “free” products, the less amount of credit you get. For example your credit goal may be 100 and you might get 50 credits for your first referral. Then your second referral is less, then less and so on. Towards the end you get 0.1 credits for a referral. You’d feel like you’re so close but you’ve already invited 20+ people and played this “game” tediously to the point where you just give up after going ham for 18 hours. I’ve gotten free products only twice and let me tell you it was no cake walk. I really had to EARN them, which is understandable but tbh, the credits getting lower and lower the more you earn as you get closer to you goal just feels scammy. Just give me a real goal so I can calculate realistically. They be like your goal is only 80! First referral gets you 50, then second gets you 10, third gets you 5, then 3 , then 1.5 , then 0.5 , then 0.3 , then 0.1 (you get the idea) tip: don’t ever try farmland it’s def the scammiest one 100%

title: 安くは購入できます
content:

・クーポンを信用せずに利用する
・安物だと割り切って購入する
以上の2点前提でなら
利用するのもありなアプリだと思います

title: Toll
content:
Ich bin echt und ich werde für die Bewertung nicht bezahlt. Daher hab ich leider auch keinen Gutscheincode für euch. Aber ich kann euch sagen: ich habe 4x bestellt. Jedes mal kam meine Bestellung zwischen 10 - 14 Tagen vollständig mit DHL oder Hermes an. Es gibt eine Sendungsverfolgung. Die Qualität der Ware war ausnahmslos top (vorher natürlich Größe und Bewertungen, besonders mit Fotos checken) und alles natürlich super günstig. Oft ist die Ware 1:1 auf Amazon zu finden. Natürlich zu einem höheren Preis. Doch letztlich kommt ja eh das meiste aus China. Nur dass man hier die Zwischenhändler nicht bezahlt.
*
Update
Ich musste leider einen Stern abziehen, da der Mindestbestellwert immer höher wird. Hab ein paar mal bestellt und anfangs war er 10€ und hat sich jetzt zu 25€ gesteigert. Das finde ich echt traurig, dass man so mit Stammkunden umgeht. Ich bestelle ja auch gerne für einen höheren Preis, damit sich der Versand lohnt, aber wenn man als Stammkunde mal ne Kleinigkeit braucht, wird man benachteiligt. Denk mal ich lösch die App jetzt.

title: 日用品はまだ使えるものもある、衣類は気をつけた方が良い。
content:
日用品や鍋などは安っぽいが、値段相応のまあ使えるものが届く。シャワーヘッドは水流調節が壊れていて、返金対応を申し込んでみたが、アプリ内で壊れていることわかる動画を要求され、返金はTEMUで次回以降使えるクレジットで返金なのでまた新しい何かを買うしかない。

レビューが⭐️5ばかりなのがよくわからない。
使えるものもあるので⭐️2つ。

title: ウザい、そろそろ我慢の限界
content:
商品が豊富。ハンドメイドの細かい部品など「こんなの売ってるの？」とか見ているだけでも楽しめる。あまりに安くて買おうか不安になるけど、まあこのお値段なら騙されても諦めがつくかなと購入を迷っている。
欲しいのは数品、それもほとんど数百円だが一定の金額を超えないと購入できない。結局金額を満たすために他の商品も買うことになる。（この工程、フェリ○モを思い出す）
まあそれは良い。
知人の紹介で始めたのだがその知人からのメッセージが面倒くさいのだ。
アプリ内のゲームであと何人やら何%やらでしょっちゅう「登録して云々」のメッセージが来る。他の人にも朝晩関係無く送っているらしい。仕事しろ。ほんとウザい。友達減るぞ。
あれを見ていると冷静になれるのでのめり込み防止にはなってはいるが。

title: 普通の買い物アプリ
content:
アリみたいな海外の安さ爆発的な買い物サイト、カードなどがなくても、2100円以上（24/5/5現）ならPayPayやコンビニ支払いで購入できるのでアリより使い勝手が良いかも、ただし0円で選んだアイテム貰えるミニゲームなどは詐欺とゆうか、まだTEMを知らない人を紹介しないと間に合わないような作りになっているので（必要人数もゲームにより違いがある、ゲーム後半から溜まらなくなるようにワザとしてある為10人位必要かと思う）ムカつく人は最初からしない方がよいと思う、後一度登録するとメールが頻繁にくるから嫌ならオフにした方がよい（オフにしてもしつこめに来る）

title: 返品すると損する仕組み
content:
返品すると支払い金額からクーポン分損する仕組みです。
5955円がクレジットから引かれて、1294円の返品する場合の返品金額の画面です。

小計　　　　　　5955円
割引額　　　　　-4658円

返品商品　　　　　1294円
クーポン適応　　　　-517円

実際の返金額　　　　780円

クーポンの割引適応後にクレジットで5955円を支払ってるのに、何故か割引額4658円とでます。

返品商品からも同様に517円割引されるので、1294円払って実際は780円しか戻らないです。

Shienで返品した際にこんな割引されて返金されたことはないので、二度とtemsは利用しません。

title: 手厚いサービス
content:
安い商品なので最初はすごく不安でした。でも、とりあえず安いから買ってみようという気持ちで購入したのが最初です。
いつもなら高くて手に入らない商品を安くで購入できて日々の暮らしに楽しさや潤いを得ることができました。
その中には使えなかったものも確かにあったのですが返品交換がとてつもなく早い。
返品の際にはクレジットとしてすぐに入ってきます。面倒くさいやりとりもありません。
そのクレジットは次の購入のときに使えるので買って後悔したということがなくなりました。
可愛いものも必需品もアイデア商品もたくさんあって閲覧するだけでも楽しいです。
娘や孫にプレゼントも何度もできました。
喜んでもらえて嬉しかったです。
それから、日本人のオペレーションの方も何度かお世話になりましたがとても親切で拙い説明にも関わらずすぐに理解していただき解決することができました。
ありがとうございました。

title: Addictive!
content:
I’ve ordered many, many times and not had any issues. I use Apple to pay, blocked the number on my phone & changed the settings so I don’t get emails unless its a order update.
DONT BOTHER PLAYING FISHLAND OR OTHER GAMES it’s impossible, it’s just a way of getting you to go on the app each day.
Always check item description/details & reviews and you’ll be fine. Items are refunded immediately if it’s under £10 without having to return.
The minimum spend is £15 but you can order, cancel items and they still send the rest of the order. Also, if you use the coupon back page the minimum order is £10. You then receive vouchers to use if you want like £10 off £30.
I get discount vouchers regularly and can get a really good deal most of the time. Check your messages for coupon back & discount pages!
I’ve been happy with most things and if not I’ve been refunded which is instant if given as temu credit or takes a couple of days if refunding to your bank.
Shop wisely and it’s great, the choice and prices are amazing!

title: 通販はやっぱりAmazonか楽天
content:
広告の7点購入で3点無料が目に入り、使い勝手どんなもんじゃいとお試しで利用してみました。
割引の額も大きく、商品も少ないわけでもなく、購入まではそこまで問題ないサービスと感じました。
先程商品がまとめて届きましたが梱包がお世辞にもキレイとは言えず、小学生が工作した段ボールのような状態でした。
その中で購入した雨傘を開封したところ、柄の付け根で曲がっており開くことができない状態でした。
アプリよりカスタマー問合せを行ったところ、AIでの問答があり、爆速で返金処理がされました。
返金が決まり安心はしたものの、梱包の酷さ、返金の決定までが早すぎて、今後の利用は正直無いかなと。
「写真も、詳しい情報も精査せず返金処理をする」梱包、配送に問題があるのを前提に商売されているように感じます。
やはり通販は大手を利用するのをオススメします。

title: Great app
content: If you love a deal and a bargain this is the app for you. I was so unsure about ordering as I’ve made the mistake in the past ordering from wish… So many of my friends had been talking about Temu… I filled my cart 20 times and emptied it again before I actually committed to a purchase. I’ve bought 5 times and only been slightly disappointed with one product. Everyone leaves reviews so it’s easy to make an informed decision when purchasing an item. Being shipped from out of the country I expected it to take a while to get my packages, but it really comes quite quickly, not much different from Amazon’s delivery times, but IF you don’t receive your package by the original estimated time they give you credits toward additional purchases. I was lucky to catch a deal with my first purchase that granted me a $90 credit once I received and reviewed my products… $90!!!! I quickly spent it and again loved everything I got. So now before I buy anything… I check Temu first. Just bought my son a grey oversized queen cooling down comforter for his bed. Guess what I paid.. $13… and the quality is fantastic! Better than what you could buy at Walmart for $60. Also bought him a set of beautiful satin sheets for $15 and a 2.5 inch memory foam bed topper for $19… not disappointed in the slightest not to mention my wallet was quite happy too! I’ve struggled to buy maternity clothes online because I can’t feel the fabrics or physical see the cuts and sizes.. one here I was comfortable because if I hated it I wasn’t out a bunch on money and I’ve been sooooo happy with everything. Ordered my daughters some clothes and they were all true to size and they loved everything. I just can’t say enough good about this app… if you have been on the fence about downloading.. it’s ok I was too.. but I promise you that you will NOT be disappointed. They constantly give coupons, credits, $1 deals… you just can’t beat it.

title: 商品が届かない
content:
約7000円のれたコードプレーヤーが初回クーポンで800円になるのでアプリを入れました。

注文をするのに、たしか1500円以上の買い物が必要だったのでレコードプレーヤーの他に安価な物を３つほど購入して注文しました。

安価な物はすぐに届いたのですが、レコードプレーヤーは届きませんでした。

対応については、800円の返金だけで再発送はできないとのことでした。

ここからは私の推察なのですが、高価な物が安く手に入るという嘘で消費者を釣り、安価な物を購入させるために1500円以上で注文可能とし、利益が出ない高価な物は結局発送しないという手法をとっていると考えました。

content:
どこのサイトを検索してもここから注文したものは安くて素敵だと書いてあるので全くあてにならなかった。 私が購入したものでクラフト関係のものは写真ではそう見えなかったけど思ってたより大きかったりするが特に問題は無い。 服や靴は1回～5回使ったら壊れたり洗濯して縮んだり、そもそも作りが悪すぎて使えなかった。 面倒だから返品しなかったけど、アパレル関係はやめておいた方が良いと思う。 手に取ってフィッティングして決める方が得策。 家電は怖くて注文出来ない。(なぜなら到着時に商品の箱が壊れている事が殆どだから。) あと注文したものが到着しましたは日本の港か空港に到着しただけでまだ日本の宅配業者用の番号の登録すらされてない。 家に届くのは到着予定日から大体4日後くらい。 たまに某大手ショッピングサイトの商品と全く同じ商品が下手すると桁違いで安くなっている時があるので梱包の丁寧さを求めなくて急ぎでなければこちらを使うとよいと思われます。 あと商品欲しさに人を紹介するやつはやめた方がいいです。 殆どの人が貰えません。 個人情報が流出するだけです。
あと｢クーポン取得○○分で3個選んで｣とか｢この商品はもうすぐ売り切れ｣とか…急かすばかりでゆっくり買い物させてくれない。
億万長者ならもっと優雅に買い物出来るはずですよ？

title: 100均の方が絶対良い
content:
支払いはApple Payでやったこともあり、返金してもらえるようで、商品到着は早かった。6つ注文して3つはゴミ品質でした。100均の廉価版の製品を300円500円で買ってしまった。星ふたつ。

返金手続きのビデオ添付はエラーでできなかった。

元値をいじるので、90％オフも半額クーポンも意味はない。そしてほぼ確実に毎日(毎時間？アプリ開くたび？)ルーレットあたるし、限定品も実はほとんどないので（同一商品が別出品者ででいっぱいある)、焦って買い物する必要はまったくない。

15000円クーポンは3000円✖️5回分、一回につき最低購入価格があり、元値をいじられるので、何の意味もないと思って貰えれば。

同じ商品の出品者と価格が違うものが実はたくさんあり、クーポン適用になるのはそのうち異様に元値が高いやつだけで、クーポン適応したら普通の価格になる。

商品画像の半分は合成か盛ってる。実態を映している本物がひとつあるかどうかなので、隅々まで確認必要。

普通に考えて、良い品質を配送無料でなんて期待しちゃいけない。
幾分かの価値はあるけど、もう使わない。ホームセンターかダイソーでいい。

title: Cheap wares, bright gimmicky animations
content: A great bargain app to explore every so often. Aside from the app itself, there are many, many, things one can find in the temu store and it can become a great little moment of treating yourself. My gripe is with the COUNTLESS ANIMATIONS. They are making my phone crash and I often have to restart the app several times within a single use, which has been the main reason I often choose NOT to use temu and just shop elsewhere. The mini games are pre-programmed to LOOK like your winning extra discounts but that is far from the truth. The games are even worse. For example the “fishland” game is very laggy, the pop-ups are ENDLESS, the increments at which you progress are very odd. In the beginning you could feed your fish 1 time to raise its growth by 1 percent, but by the 70% or so for each fish, that feeding is now increasing the growth by .01%, its painstaking to watch that, and then be expected to keep playing the terrible game for some “free” items, and useless coupons. My advice: if you can get past the ultra-annoying, stupid games and animations, you COULD have a fun shopping experience, but as of yet, prepare for a pseudo-seizure.

title: 個人的には有りかと
content:
色々と話題のtemuだが、使用した感想としては個人的には有りです。例えばAmazonやYショッピングの品物とほぼ同じです。最低購入額も有りますが、ある程度欲しい物が重なればAmazonとの金額差が生まれます。配達はやはり1週間前後掛かるので急いで欲しい人には向きませんが、取り敢えず欲しい時には丁度良いです。クーポンや割引などを駆使すれば大丈夫か❓って位の購入量になりますが、金額は1,000〜2,000で済みます。カード払いに不安があるのでコンビニ払いにしてますが殆どタイムラグ（2時間位）が無いので発送自体も早いです。通関に2〜3日は掛かります。
無料で数点ゲットは紹介も必要だったりと無料も条件が厳しいので割引クーポン（〇〇円引きや%OFF）だけでも十分です。あくまでも中国の品物なので不安や国産の安心感求める人では無く、機能に問題無しで有ればOKの人は選択肢に入れても良いかも。仮に不良品だとしても返金フォームが有るので対応としては良いと思います。

title: Nothing ventured, nothing gained
content: I started ordering from Temu about six weeks ago. There delivery by UPS and the USPS are fantastic and accurate.  I have spent about $500 on various products as a test before I bought more expensive items. It is vary frustrating trying to get the point across that a purchase with parts missing is worthless. Only a partial credit was offered. I was not allowed a supervisor and said no further orders would be placed. Another rep came on the chat and said a complete product would be shipped immediately. This took over an hour and may be the plan. It did arrive complete and quicker than normal.  Ontrac is the local delivery service.  Imho they are not reliable or trustworthy.  They are hitting under50%. One delivery never showed. They did not provide a photo of delivery and I have cameras on my property, although I live in a good neighborhood.  It took almost two hours between the two companies.  Ontrac backed their driver on a delivery of a one inch cube.  Temu replaced the 24lb package.    The latest incident said delivery was made at 10:36 AM. I was at home and spent almost two hours trying to get the point across that it was not delivered here. At 4 PM I was walking in my neighborhood when a stranger came up and handed my package that was delivered to his house. Neither TEMU nor ONTRAC will acknowledge this error , nor apologize for it. Both sent notice that delivery was made to my home.  Due to this lack of communication, I will no longer be ordering. I have one order in progress and am hoping for the best.

title: 詐欺に近いんじゃないでしょうか
content:
先日オールスター◯謝祭でコラボ？をやっていたこともあり、試しに家族が購入しました。
ルーレットを回して何%オフとかで割引があり、計9品選べることになりいくつかの商品からひとつずつ選んでいきました。
TEMUが初めてだったので色々レビューやら評価などを見てあまり良くないかな？と思いましたが、良かった人もいたので試しに購入してみました。
ルーレットの当たりが良かったこともあり、パソコン機器諸々9点とバッグと簡易マッサージみたいのを購入しました。
本日届いて開けてみますと、購入したパソコン画面は入っておらず、パソコンの箱がペシャンコに折り曲げられた間にヘッドフォンなどの購入したものが入っていました。
メインのパソコン画面が入っていないことには驚きました。
すぐに問い合わせをしチャットでのやり取りの中、パソコンは届いていないのでいつ届くのか確認すると、発送はできないとのこと。
結局、返金対応となりましたがコンビニ払いにしていたのでアプリ内でしか使えないポイント？みたいなものでの返金になるみたいで、またここから買わなくちゃいけないのか...と。
安さや無料で試しに購入したこともあり、そこまできちんとした物は届かないとは思っていましたが、まさかメインのパソコンが箱だけでしかもペシャンコでテープでぐるぐる巻きになっていたのには逆に笑えました。
今まで色々なサイトから購入をしておりますがここまで酷い所はないですね。

title: Ich habe zwar schon wirklich oft bei Temu bestellt
content:
Aber es gibt immer wieder Probleme.
Sehr häufig kommen Waren kaputt an. Weite Reise und die Sachen sind oft ewige Zeiten unterwegs. Dann werden sie nur in Plastiktüten verpackt gesendet. Wird halt viel zerdrückt. Manchmal fehlen Artikel und am meisten Probleme haben wir dann Vorort mit unserem Lieferdienst. Waren kommen gar nicht an und werden nicht im Paketshop abgegeben sondern vor die Tür geschmissen, in der Nachbarschaft abgegeben oder kommen gar nicht an.
Bestellte Ware ist immer in separatenPlastikbeuteln verpackt. Bestellt man 20 Artikel, bekommt man 20 Verpackungen.
Viele Sachen (Kleidung) kommt viel kleiner als angegeben, selten passgenau aber auch mal zu groß. Man muss sehr viel Ware retournieren.
Vieles ist aber auch einfach extrem minderwertiger Schrott und viele Produkte kann man in Deutschland auch wirklich zum gleichen Preis kaufen. Wenn bei mir jetzt irgendwann mal alles angekommen ist, werde ich die App löschen und nicht mehr bei Temu bestellen. Man produziert einfach wirklich viel zu viel Müll.

title: Shop Temu!!
content: I’m not one to write reviews, but I think Temu has earned it.  I have bought a lot from Temu, after many months of debating whether or not I should, I took a chance.  I ordered some flowers because they looked so beautiful in the ad, and I think I’ve possibly bought at least one of every kind of flower they sell by now.  The colors are brilliant.  They are even more beautiful in hand than they are in the picture.  They’re just gorgeous!  I also love shiny things, like jewelry and Temu has so many types of jewelry to choose from.  I especially like the ones with rhinestones, and Temu delivers on all points. I’ve ordered clothes, I even ordered two of the same dress so if one gets ruined, I’ll still have one.  So far the clothes have exceeded my expectations. They fit like they’re supposed to, they wash well & I’ve even gotten compliments when I wear them.  The only part of buying from Temu that frustrates me, is the bonus and/or free spins to get more perks.  Of course having a chance to buy more & pay less is the ultimate goal, but I haven’t seen how any part of spinning the wheel or trying to buy a given number of items within a short period of time to get the bonus prizes, has benefitted me at all.  So I feel like they get your attention by offering the bigger discounts that you win if you use it within a given time frame, but I’ve never noticed where I have benefitted from “winning” a discounted price.  That’s really the only disappointing part of shopping with Temu for me.  And I’m not saying that it doesn’t work for everybody, it just hasn’t worked for me, and for that reason I do refrain from buying more than I already do.  If you’re on the fence trying to decide if you should or shouldn’t, take a chance.  Buy just a couple little things, there’re millions of things to choose from, and if you don’t have a good experience, then maybe it’s not for you, but I believe Temu has something for everybody.  I love love love shopping with them.  Go Temu!!!

title: 詐欺スレスレです。
content:
「6商品、無料」のような釣り文句で、会員登録させます。
実際にダウンロードしてみると、確かに一見、無数の商品に「無料」という文字が並びます。

一見、表面上に書かれている条件は「それ以外に５つの商品を購入すること」だけです。

しかし、目に見えないほど小さなアイコンに気付き、
詳しい条件が書いていそうなのでクリックしたところ…

「条件で定められた数の商品を購入した場合に、
その中で最も安い商品が6つ無料になる」ということが判明しました。

つまり、例えばこの場合は11点もの購入をしなければならず、そのうち安い物6点が無料になるだけです。

表示法に抵触していることが明らかであり、中華製の最悪なアプリです。

そんなんしなくても買います笑。

到着も最終期限より3日も早くつきました。
全く不安なく安心でした。
またすぐリピートさせていただきます。
ありがとうございます。

title: よくわからない。
content:
値段は安く、いいかなと思い初めました。
ただ、選んだ商品5つ無料とかは、正直めんどくさいです。
というのも、5つ商品を選択し、終えると、合計金額から値引きがされ始めます。
あれやこれや、理由をつけて残り200円まで値引きをしてくれますが、ここからがめんどくさいです。
友達を招待すれば値段が引かれるとのこと。
兄弟にラインで招待し、妹にアプリを入れてもらい値引きの条件が達成されました。これを数人にしてもらい、
1人招待で－100円(残り100円)、次招待して－50円(残り50円)、また次招待して－30円(残り20円)、またまた招待して－10円(残り10円)、招待して-3円(残り7円)と。
一体どれだけ招待すればいいのか。
また、その招待でラインまたは、Googleなどを使用しログインするので、もし個人情報がってなると、不安も💦
もちろん、5つの商品が無料(本当かわかりませんが)になるなら、仕方ないのかなと思いますが、なんせ何も説明がなく、何人招待も言われないので、正直安くても不安が勝ちました。
またそれから先はやってないので、購入できてません。
沢山の人が達成されてます！とちょくちょく出てきますが、ほんとに？とも思ってしまいました。
別に下げコメントをしたい訳では無いですが、もう少し説明を増やすなどして欲しいものです。

title: Good service but be sceptical of time sensitive offers
content: If Temu gives you something free especially if it's a time sensitive offer, there are likely limitations and restrictions on it, and it won’t always be completely transparent and clear from the offset. It’s not necessarily that these free benefits aren’t worth it, but I really wish they would make it way more obvious when they offer you a coupon bundle worth $40 in exchange for spending a certain amount (especially a new customer), what exactly you’re going to need to do (spoiler: spend more money) to be able to even use any of those coupons. I was very upset after placing my first order and realizing that the coupons I got require minimum order amounts so high that I probably won't use them. That being said, I’m extremely happy with the products I received through their introductory offer, and they were well worth the amount of money that I paid even if I never use the coupons I received. I will probably ignore the coupon bundles and urgent offers, but you can’t beat these prices as long as your comfortable with a bit of a gamble.

title: They lie about your privacy
content:
This company maintains a constant surveillance of your day-to-day activities. It distributes advertisements to all of your social media applications and allows you to conduct regular searches on search engines. The click baiting on my accounts is at an all-time high. The things that I purchased were also delivered a significant amount of time later than what was promised. However, despite the fact that the products I bought were at a reasonable price, the general quality of the items I bought was particularly poor.
However, whoever manages this company will have complete access to all of your personal information. Your information will be distributed to various locations throughout the world by them. Almost immediately after downloading this application, I received a notification informing me that my personal information had been uploaded to the dark web. How convenient is that! At this point, the only advertisements that I come across in every search and on every other website are for products that I have no interest in purchasing. Even if you only search for it once, this company will continue to bother you until you make a purchase of the product or service they are trying to attract your attention to.
Frustration that never seems to end, to put it mildly. Alongside Google, Meta is also involved in this scheme with them. In my opinion, there is no reason to doubt that "X" is planning to exploit them for advertising purposes as well. If you decide to use this app, you should be aware that you will be giving up a significant amount of your confidential information.

title: Please read!
content:
I found Temu to be incredibly frustrating to use. The app is cluttered and unintuitive, making it difficult to navigate and find what you're looking for. Product listings are often inaccurate or misleading, leading to disappointment upon delivery. Customer service is virtually non-existent, with slow response times and unhelpful support staff. Overall, I would not recommend Temu for anyone looking for a reliable and enjoyable shopping experience. Another aspect that disappointed me about Temu is the lack of quality control. Many of the items I purchased turned out to be of inferior quality, and some even arrived damaged or defective. Additionally, shipping times were excessively long, with no option for expedited delivery. Overall, my experience with Temu left me feeling frustrated and dissatisfied. Despite its promises of cheap shopping, Temu fails to deliver on multiple fronts. The app is plagued with technical glitches and crashes, making it nearly impossible to complete a transaction smoothly. Furthermore, the advertised discounts often turn out to be misleading, with prices fluctuating unpredictably during checkout. The customer review system is unreliable, with many fake or incentivized reviews skewing perceptions of product quality. Overall, Temu's lack of transparency and poor user experience make it a regrettable choice for anyone seeking affordable shopping options.

Thank you for your time😅. Have a good day/night

title: Best shopping app
content: With our current economy Temu is the only way I have been able to start replacing our decade old wardrobe. I’ve also found some nice sensory items for a couple of my kids. I’ve only received a small handful of items that weren’t what they appeared to be or the sizing was wrong. Customer support is better than anywhere else too! The money for those items was quickly returned and I was able to donate them to the homeless community. That’s an AMAZING thing! I have two suggestions though. I wear an extra small in tops and the selection in that size is VERY limited. I would like more of the women’s clothing to be available in an extra small. Also, I think we would all benefit from some type of organization in our carts. Maybe categories like ‘for me’ ‘for Hollidays’ ‘for house’ or even something as simple as being able to rearrange the items in the cart. I’ve had over $700 of stuff in my cart that I would slowly buy as I could afford it. I would have to scroll through the ENTIRE cart to select the items I needed to buy first. If we could simply hold and drag items in the cart to reorganize them it would be HUGELY beneficial to MOST of the people who use this app. I literally bought our entire Christmas from temu this past year and it was difficult to order each payday because I would have to look through the cart to find the items I could afford or were most important. It’s pretty time consuming. ALOT of people see something they like or want and hit ‘add to cart’ so they can save it for later. When it’s time to actually buy those things it’s a bit frustrating that we can’t even organize those ‘to buy’ items. Please add some type of organizing feature. Thank you so much for making it possible to afford gifts for friends and family as well as clothing for my entire household.

title: Great products/questionable billing
content:
There’s no arguing that Temu has some great products at good, affordable prices. The designs featured in a lot of departments are funkier than they a year or so ago, more modern and keeping with current design trends. There’s something here for everyone though regardless of your tastes. On the whole I’ve been very pleased with the quality of the products I have purchased. Great prices and well made clothing, etc. I expect the pieces I purchased to last, just be careful of any garments with a large percentage of polyester - they will pill after machine washing. I tried to stick with 100 percent cotton.

That said, despite their apparently meticulous receipts and records, it still results in some confusion and I was distressed to find some discrepancies between what they say I was charged for and what I actually paid. I have not broached this with Customer Service yet so I cannot comment on how they will handle this. However, I have had other issues like a lost package & they were very accommodating and helpful, giving me credit for one portion of the total order even though the box was eventually located.

The prices change rapidly so stay on top of that & get refunds for any price drops. Often there are multiple listings for items that will show them for different price points, do your due diligence! Some descriptions of items were not accurate(a bedspread that is definitely not a ‘quilt’), but on the whole I have been very pleased with the quality of the items I have purchased. The workmanship is not shoddy & I expect the items to last. And you can’t beat the prices! The designs are funky and fun. I always want more than I can afford!

だけど届かないこともあるらしく、その場合支払い方法がクレカだと返金がサイト内通貨になるそう。
その対策としてPayPal利用した方がいいらしい。

title: Great App, Low Prices, Quality Items
content:
I know people have been leery of downloading this app but I can say I’ve been using it for 6+ months and it’s been great. This would be a 5-star review if it weren’t for the annoying game popups that are nearly impossible to win.
A few points: 1) nearly all the items I’ve bought have been high quality. Look at the descriptions, measurements and reviews before committing. Clothing sizes run true to size. I’m very impressed! 2) customer service is excellent. When I receive an item that isn’t to my satisfaction I can easily go to my orders, locate that item and request return. Most of the time they just credit your form of payment or credit your Temu account if preferred and often don’t even ask for a return. 3) as mentioned, the popups for their multiple games (free items, gift cards, etc.) are really intrusive. They’re like those telemarketers who always bug you when you’re trying to do something. This is the reason I dropped the review to 4-stars. 4) excellent communication regarding your order status or if an out of stock item is now back in stock.

title: Great deals at a huge expense!
content: This company nonstop spies on your everyday activity.  It pushes ad content  to all your social media apps and regular searches on search engines.   My accounts are click baited to death. The products I purchased were also delivered way later than promised.  The overall quality of the products I purchased wasn’t bad for the price but they came at a huge expense.  Yes you get a deal.  However, you lose all your privacy to whomever runs this company.  They will broker your information off all over the world.  Shortly after downloading this app I was notified that my information had ended up on the dark web.  How convenient! Now all I see in every search and on every other web-site are ads for product I want nothing to do with.  If you search for it once, this company will harass you till no end till you make a purchase of that product or service.  Endless frustration to say the least.  Meta is in on it with them along with Google.  I wouldn’t doubt it’s in the works for “X” to use them also for ad revenue.   If you choose to download this app know very well you are giving up pretty much all your privacy.  I also wonder if their vendors have patent infringement suits against them as most of the product I ordered was copied almost to the original product design of what I was looking for.   Read the end user agreement carefully.  Some deals just aren’t worth the hassle.

title: Bad quality, but not the worst
content:
In general I didn’t mind buying from Temu. However recently I’ve been trying, both myself and my family, to actively participate in the “free gifts” part of the app (the main reason I joined). However no one I know, family or otherwise, myself included, ever seem to be able to win them. They make it far too difficult to participate, let alone win. And they always make it so you only $1 or 2 away from “winner”. But in reality, you need over 100 clicks/referrals to get anything (and that’s AFTER you cut the price down to $1-2). So you just feel like it was on you for not managing to get it.

The need to make it possible to just pay the remaining balance on this “free gifts”, because “winning” them is near impossible.

And to top it off, customer service is next to useless with assisting anything about these promotions. The links are usually wonky and you’ll spend hours just begging people online for clicks. I would definitely not recommend this app for this. However, if you’re interested in just buying crappy, low quality items (with occasional hidden gems) then Temu is great. Just don’t waste all your time trying to get free gifts. Trust me, not worth it.

title: I See You
content: So Temu is an application that promotes getting items for free/cheap. I’ve noticed a pattern though, new users get a taste of getting free stuff off the bat, but once the user tries to apply for more free stuff they have to continually share with people who don’t have Temu or already existing users. But my suspicion rises when I noticed that in the fine print (The rules of the game will change) surely that doesn’t matter…until it says you need to share a link with someone to cut one dollar off your product, so you share the link and wait, once they accept the link it cuts only ¢50. You look at what the values of shared links are and they changed the rules, you get $1 off of your items if you share to someone who doesn’t have Temu, but if you share to someone who already has Temu, it cuts off ¢1…but that doesn’t make sense, you already shared a link with your friend who already has Temu and it cut ¢50. That’s what they do, they want you to share with as many people as possible only to dangle the items you want infront off your face only inches away. They give you a taste of free items only for you to go through hoops upon hoops just to get those items, and I’m not going to lie, the clothes are fine but other items are poorly made. I don’t recommend this app especially to people who have gambling addictions.

5.	Bait-and-Switch Tactics: I’ve also been concerned about bait-and-switch tactics, where I was enticed by an offer that turned out to be unavailable and then was directed towards other, often more expensive or less desirable, products, as noted by some reviewers.

title: Find literally anything!
content:
You could spend hours finding things you didn’t know you needed! It’s quite fun. The app works as it should and so far the company delivers the product on time (usually earlier than expected), and stand behind what they sell. The only caution is that they always offer you “deals” and freebies, but you have to invite everyone you know to download the app in order to get said goodies. You usually end up one “coin” or one dollar short of being able to redeem the offer.
Some things they sell are just cheap and you truly get what you pay for. However, I’ve purchased lots of super inexpensive costume jewelry that ends up being great quality. I am obsessed with earrings. Temu’s earrings rival ones I’d normally buy at a nice department store and cost a fraction of the price. That rates them 5-star even when I stupidly think I can cash in on hundreds of dollars for hounding people to download their app, knowing full well that will never happen.

title: Overspent & Underpaid 🫣🫣🫣
content:
I am really enjoying this site ..
Everything  is such a reasonable/bargain price u would automatically aSSume u get what u paid for but this is definitely NOT the case here ..

I have bought a variety of items from ladies to kids clothes (both sexes)..  trainers.. toys.. novelty.. kitchen.. phone stuff.. diy.. stationary..  it has all been sturdy or better ..  easy to use .. for me it has all been the exact description or more .. the size and pigmentation have always been spot on or bolder.. title: The app is great but the shipping
content:
Temu is pretty great. I have found some pretty great items on Temu. I have to say that I have been  enjoying Temu and have spent a lot of time browsing the App and have bought quite a lot on it from kitchen gadgets to clothing. I have bought puzzles to purses. While I expect my items to take awhile for shipping do to the fact that it is coming from mainland China the lack of information for shipping and tracking does get frustrating. Also about half of my packages DO NOT arrive on time. The company offers $5.00 credit when your package does not arrive by the date that it is due to arrive which is nice but is not really nothing when your packages are constantly late. Currently I am waiting for 3 packages to arrive. I had 2 shipments that was split into 3. All of them are late. 1 is suppose to arrive by tomorrow, Monday but is not due to arrive until Tuesday. The other 2 do not even have tracking information with the post office for the last 4 days. Both of them were due to be delivered by Tuesday or in 2 days. It looks like Temu will owe me some more credits. They have already in the past when I package full of Christmas stocking stuffers came 11 days late. It was due to arrive December 9th but did not arrive until December 20th. I was beginning to panic a little then.
Either way as I am waiting for my next round of packages to arrive from Temu I did my reviews on all 75 items that I have recently purchased. I am very happy to continue browsing the site for more purchases. Some worth them money and are very nice items and some maybe not so much. Either way it is worth the effort and is fine site.

title: Erstbestellung hat mich überzeugt
content:
Insgesamt habe ich vier Produkte bestellt. Eine Fleecemütze (leider etwas klein-gab es nur in Einheitsgröße), 5 T-Shirts als Unterhemden, 2 Sport T-Shirts und eine Hundedecke zur Abdeckung unseres Betts.

Die Lieferzeit mit 10 Tagen war für mich auch akzeptabel, da ich von vornherein wusste, dass die Lieferung aus China kommt. Auch war ich über den Sendungsverlauf immer informiert und konnte hier sehen, dass die Lieferung nicht per Schiff, sondern per Luftfracht nach Europa kam und von der Niederlande zu mir nach Hause geliefert kam.

Nach dieser ersten Erfahrung ist TEMU eine Empfehlung. Allerdings hatte ich aufgrund von Erfahrungen mit anderen Internetanbieter aus China durchaus etwas „Bauchgrummeln“.

Well done.
