title: WHAT A SCAM TEMU IS!
content:
First off, they jack the prices WAYY up so that it looks like your getting a great deal, when in reality you’re probably spending more money than if you would have bought a less crappy version of the item you were wanting to buy in the first place.
I spent around ten bucks on the app because they said if I spent 10 then they would gift me a $300 gift card. So I purchased the $10 items and then they gave me the gift card just as they said…but I had less than 48 hours to use the whole $300 and they jacked the prices up so really I wasn’t saving any money. & somehow my cart had a $2.00 flag in it + a $1 keychain with free shipping and somehow my total was a full $16?! Because they said the original price of the flag was $30 and the keychain was about $16 and they then gave me a “good deal” when if I would have not used a gift card I could have bought it all for $3!!! So I didn’t want to use the gift card anymore because it was beyond a SCAM! Then when I went to buy the items without the gift card I then saw there was a stupid $15 minimum that you could spend!!! This should be illegal because you can’t force people to spend a minimum about!!! At that point I was totally and completely DONE WITH TEMU!..Then my package arrived with my $10 items. I bought these crunched socks and a star room projector. First off the socks were NOTHING as described, they were just regular socks with no scrunch! & the projector came in a beat up, torn up, open box and the projector was broken! I am not pleased with this app, they did NOT woo me and I will never be using it again, along with recommending it to no one!

title: So close to perfect!
content: I genuinely love Temu, I have found so many items that have quickly become staples in my everyday life. It’s no surprise that with the day to day financial strain on most people these days, it’s is really hard to keep up with trends. Most people today can’t afford good quality accessories, makeup, toys, clothes, electronics, gadgets, etc; but Temu makes it possible. The only thing that would make this app better is a change or improvement in the earning tasks. I don’t keep in touch with very many people and even though I share the promos and try to invite new people, it’s nearly impossible to earn all the rewards available. It would be really great if there were mini games that can be played to earn more credits. That is the only suggestion I could make in regards to improvement, I think it would create a boost in incentive for the continued support of loyal customers. Aside from that, Temu is awesome!

title: Poor customer service
content: The first order I placed went smoothly, and completely without issues, though my second, I received someone else’s package, which was confirmed when I peeled back a label revealing a completely different name and address. Upon trying to gain some kind of refund or reimbursement I was told I could not gain store credit due to “suspicious activity” (trying to get a refund) and I would not be receiving the money in my account for up to an entire month (!!) essentially, 50 quid gone and let’s face it, very unlikely to return. The worst part is that my friends have told me similar stories about THEIR orders which means that this is clearly a recurring issue but has not been fixed. Get the app if you want cheap stuff but just be cautious is my advice.

Using the Temu app is like going on a blind date with your favorite products – you never know if you'll end up with a charming suitor or a quirky companion. The app's hit-or-miss item quality keeps me on my toes, turning each purchase into a surprise party where the gift is wrapped in uncertainty.

And then there are those moments when it recommends something so outlandishly off the mark that you can't help but chuckle, appreciating the app's attempt at humor.

Customer support, much like a stand-up comedian, responds promptly and with a dash of wit. They turn potential shopping hiccups into anecdotes, leaving you with a smile even when things don't go as planned.

In the grand comedy of online shopping, Temu takes center stage with its mix of unpredictability, clever recommendations, and a support team that's quick with a witty retort. So, if you're up for a shopping experience that comes with a side of humor and a pinch of unpredictability, let Temu be your comedic retail companion.

title: 「TEMUクレジットに返金」に注意
content:
返品する際に「TEMUクレジット」に返金を選ばせようとしてくるので注意して下さい！

TEMUクレジットはTEMU内でしか使えず日本円に払い戻しもできないので、何度もTEMUで買い物をする方でなければ価値の無い仮想通貨です。
コンビニ支払いにすると返金はこのTEMUクレジットしか選べません。
クレカやPayPalで支払えば「元の支払い方法に返金」で日本円に返金されますが、返金方法を選ぶ際に「TEMUクレジットに返金」という選択肢が二度も出てきます。

SHEINであればSHEIN内のウォレットクレジットは元のPayPalやクレカに返金できるので、SHEINの方がよっぽど信用できます。
それにSHEINはしょっちゅう割引クーポンを出していますので、同じ商品でもSHEINの方が安い場合が多いです。
TEMUでは購入した商品について競合他社の方が安ければTEMUクレジットに「だけ」なら返金してくれるらしいですが。

返品しなくて済むとか無駄金使っても気にしないなら気にする必要はないかと思います。
ただTEMUの商品説明はGoogle翻訳のようで分かりにくい上に、梱包も雑に袋に突っ込んであるだけなので、説明と違う商品や壊れた商品が届く可能性が高いです。
海外通販ならそれは仕方ないですし、返品無料なので良いのですが、とにかくTEMUクレジットだけは困りものです。
ちなみにクレジットと無料ギフトを獲得、というものはどれも新規TEMUユーザーを何人も紹介しないとクリアできません。もちろんファームランドもそうです。

【追記】TEMU公式からのコメントがついていますが、コンビニ支払いだと絶対にTEMUクレジットにしか返金できません。PayPalでもクレカでもしつこくTEMUクレジットに返金させようとしてきます。本当に注意して下さい。

title: Shopping is great, but Temu policies and offers are deceptive
content:
I have been ordering from Temu for quite some time, and for the most part I love it. The prices are good, and I’ve rarely had a problem with an order. Those times I have experienced a problem Temu has quickly made it right. However, even their customer support agents don’t understand Temu’s arbitrary policies. For instance, Temu has a price adjustment policy that you are told in plain language that, if the same item you purchased is lowered by the seller within 30 days, you will receive a refund for the difference. But then when it arbitrarily isn’t applied the customer support agent has to send you a different policy that would take a team of mathematicians to figure out! Also beware that you will be endlessly badgered to promote Temu to your friends. Don’t even attempt one of the “free items” ploys. Unless you have thousands of friends that are not already using Temu, or you put $60 orders in every week, you will be feeding fish or growing crops for months, and I do mean months! (Fishland game and Farmland game) Save yourself the trouble and just buy the items; otherwise, you will find yourself stuck in a game that you hate but don’t want to stop playing, because by the time you realize it is practically impossible to win you already have too much time invested to just throw it all away.
So, if you are looking for some good prices, you will find them on Temu. Just don’t fall into the trap of being a marketing agent, and don’t rely too heavily on promises and procedures.

title: BEWARE- HUGE SCAM TACTICS ALL THE TIME!
content:
I’ve received notices from friends and from Temu multiple times telling me if I share the app 4-5 times, I’ll will $100-$150 and so will the friend I share it to.  I guess I’m just gullible, because I have it a try all 3 times (thinking maybe there was a Technical issue or something- benefit of a doubt). EVERY time I’d share and share, keep spinning, and every time it would claim I’m just 3 points and 1 or 2 more shares away from winning the credits.  NOT ONCE did it give me any type of prize or even store credits! And I had shared it close to 100 times!!
It is just a shady scam for the site to get free advertising and give false hope.
Every time they ask you to spin while shopping, you only get a “discount” AFTER you spend a certain dollar amount.  The products themselves take about 2 months to receive and are of pretty cheap/poor quality!! I tried to reach someone to return an item and never received any reply.   I won’t contribute to them anymore-  their tactics are so dishonest and creepy!  Bad vibes & rip off!

title: Temu is great value
content:
Personally I highly recommend shopping on Temu for its terrific value and excellent service. The help setup works well and I am not good with computers so if I can figure it out anyone can.

Recently they have offered a partial refund without a return for 2 Xmas items I bought which don’t fit me. I declined and took a full refund on this occasion but another time I accepted the partial refund.

title: So far I have been happy
content: Most of the products are true to there description. I like the tshirts and jerseys but other clothing not so much. All the socks are great. My camping equipment was great quality and priced right. The electronics so far have been okay. My fairy lights and gnomes were the best purchase I made.?unfortunately the sunflower solar lights only made it this summer. Don’t think I can use them again they look faded and beat up from sun. title: Good but stay away from the games!
content:
I was amazed at how good the quality was on my first few order. Things did get a little worse as the orders went on but even if the sizes were off, the prints were bad or the items weren’t as described, they refunded pretty quickly on their easy return system but…

The free gift games are the scam part. They’re designed for you to sign up every friends you have, then bombard them with countless links on a daily basis to give temu free marketing. I’ve signed up 15 friends, played every day for 7 months, collected all the bonuses and linked with countless existing users to join in but the rules keep changing where you need to add MORE friends and annoy the ones you have with dozens of links a daily!! I’m still at least another month off and the prizes I wanted to win (A Drone) has been discontinued, leaving me with tacky options I don’t even want, for the value of $26.

In short, buy stuff while the prices are low and don’t waste your time on the “free stuff”.

title: Temu has the good, the bad, and the ugly.
content:
Temu has the good, bad, and ugly. When all things run smoothly they are amazing. When there is a problem, they fail miserably! In general my products are as described. My problems have been mostly with deliveries. As in never received. When this happens they do not have a plan for accurate investigation. The customer service agents fail more often than help. Temu holds and uses what should be your refund money as operating capital. This year it has required hundreds of hours of my time to peruse resolution. This is a painful process. Sometimes eventually I am issued a return of my funds. Typically this is many months of outrageous negotiation to have them do an effective investigation. Often they refuse my refund after an incomplete investigation. I suggest sending photos of your home, and be diligent asking hundreds of times if that is what it takes.
The reward is great. You can’t beat the prices. The pitfalls are deep. Loosing your entire purchase amount when they refuse to do an actual investigation and refuse to return your money is a painful experience…
They have a lot of issues to fix!

title: Käfer in meinem Paket
content:
Zuerst möchte ich betonen, dass ich grundsätzlich recht entspannt im Umgang mit Apps bin. Die Anwendung von Temu hat mich größtenteils überzeugt – bis zu dem gestrigen Vorfall. Ein Paket, das ich erwartete, enthielt einen Käfer. Es ist schwer in Worte zu fassen, wie abstoßend und ekelerregend diese Entdeckung war. Ich hoffe, ihr könnt die Unannehmlichkeit nachempfinden, die so ein Ereignis verursacht.

Nicht nur, dass der Käfer, den ich vorfand, wenig ansprechend aussah, sondern auch die Tatsache, dass ich mich darauf einlassen musste, mit dem Temu Chatbot zu kommunizieren, um das Problem zu klären, hat meine Zufriedenheit beeinträchtigt. Die Rückerstattung meines Geldes ist zwar erfolgt, doch der unangenehme Eindruck bleibt bestehen.

Es fällt mir schwer zu glauben, dass ich in meinem gesamten Leben noch nie etwas so Ekelhaftes erlebt habe. Es wirft definitiv Fragen zur Qualitätssicherung auf. Es ist fair anzumerken, dass die Kleidungsstücke an sich von akzeptabler Qualität sind, sogar besser als erwartet. Dennoch überwiegt der ekelerregende Vorfall und wirft einen Schatten auf die ansonsten positive Wahrnehmung von Temu. Ich hoffe, dass solche Vorfälle künftig vermieden werden, um das Vertrauen der Kunden zu erhalten.

title: Coupon Scams
content:
In general, the products are ok as long as you read the reviews. The cost of items are usually reasonable. Where my issue lies is that I was given 90% off one item and 50% off another seven items. For me, this worked out really well because I was looking at items over $40. I had to slots left to fill when I was kicked out of the offer. I thought if I closed and reopened the app, I could fix the issue. Instead, everything turned to regular price and my little boxes at the bottom to fill were gone. I went on chat to help fix the problem. We determined that I should have the discount and that I had several hours to complete. However, there was nothing the representative could do to rectify the issue.

After being left on read for 15 minutes, I was told that even though I was eligible, the most they could do is give me 20% off the orders total. I already have a bad vibe from the way you have to share the app and all these weird things for coupons only for it to never work. This was just icing on the cake. I would just recommend that you be careful when it comes to coupons and limited time discounts as they are usually a scam

And don’t forget your human or furry children. Temu has a lot to offer everyone from gamers to the glamorous. There are many fun toys and puzzles, jewelry to wear for every holiday and home decor to match. I highly recommend taking a peek into a whole other very addicting and satisfying realm of online shopping. Have fun with it!

What's truly infuriating is their refusal to acknowledge responsibility. They insisted they sent the order and washed their hands of any further responsibility. It's a clear case of taking money without delivering the goods and then blaming the customer for their own shortcomings.

I strongly advise against dealing with Temu. Save yourself the trouble and money – this company does not live up to even the basic standards of customer service and integrity.

title: Too Scamy
content:
Downloaded because I was interested in a cat water fountain, got an offer of $300 off, 96% off, and a 3 free items of five selected. Too good to be true? Very much so.

If you are looking for something specific you will never find it as we have to look scroll through the tons of offers without the use of the search and filters. Found the pet fountain you want? Good luck with those filters or pump replacement for that specific fountain listed anywhere on the other page. If you leave that page to go to the main page for the search function, you loose the offers. If you switch to your browser to search via google and happen to click on a link for temu, you are directly ported back to the app and to a new offer loosing your current one, but the items you already selected are still in your checkout and the app tries to act as if you hit purchase. It will fail so long as you don't have your purchase info already entered (hit the X when it prompts after selecting your first item).

I don’t want to have to scroll through obvious adult accessories, and other things I have no interest in. I certainly don’t want to be tricked into purchasing anything whether being an item period, or a similar item just a different size / a part of the item. Lastly, I don’t want my time wasted which is all this app seems to do.

title: Love this app
content:
I got this app a few months ago, and now I'm addicted. Everything on here is so cheap, and all the time, Temu launches a big sale, some coupons, or even free gifts altogether.
Some of their items can be a little sketchy, but as long as you're careful, you're practically guaranteed great products for the cheapest price out there.
What I've heard about Temu recently is completely the opposite from what I've personally experienced. All the products I've received have good quality, or at least acceptable for the price. I've only ever had one package come late, and when it did, they reimbursed me $10! Extremely rarely, you may find an item or two missing, but it's never anything detrimental.
While you may find something missing, or maybe an item doesn't work, you can still apply for a refund. In my case, they gave me a full refund and allowed me to keep the items, and I could donate it as I pleased! They have great customer service and I literally couldn't ask for better! Thank you Temu for the great products and cheap prices!

title: Service problems!
content: I love the prices Temu offers.  Unfortunately, The quality is very unpredictable and I experienced problems with the mail service.  Although Temu was not to blame for that, I feel the service involved with refunding my money to me not only took an insane amount of time but required me requesting it be done probably 20 times.  They kept sending me the exact same response without taking the documents I forwarded into account at all.  Had they reviewed the documentation from the courier service, they would have easily seen it was delivered to the wrong address and the person did return it according to UPS.  Temu refused the return of the item.  This was a $160 order which they were refusing to reimburse me for and it was very frustrating.  On a positive note, my orders have been delivered very quickly, had it been the right place.  I did finally receive a full refund on my entire order however it took persistence!  They claim to have a shipping guarantee so I was not expecting to have so much difficulty over a mailing issue.  The courier flat out refused to help me at all!  The customer service people were all very friendly on the phone but overall this was not a good way to represent themselves.  Knowing if your package is stolen off your doorstep, delivered to the wrong place, or simply lost will result in the customer being charged for an order they never even received, has made me decide not to order from Temu in the future.  They should stand behind their service promises without causing their customer more inconvenience than they already experienced by not receiving their order.  Then they should be able to address it with the courier at a later time so the customer is not delayed further.

title: 詐欺まがいの行為が許されるアプリ
content: SHEINや7s Goods等と違って毎日チェックインしてポイントをもらえるだとか、ミニゲームに挑戦してポイントをもらえる等はありません。ネット上でよく見る「5個無料」などは人を誘わなければいけません。1人新規で招待してもまだ「5個無料」の条件には達しません。だからTikTokなどで「交換しましょう」という内容のものをよく見ると思います。なぜなら何人も何人も誘わなければポイントが付与されないからです。それにも関わらず「お客様同士のトラブルには一切関与しません」という対応です。私は番号をお互いに検索し合ってお互いにポイントが入るようにしましょうという誘いに乗りましたが、相手が私の番号を検索することはありませんでした。つまり相手にのみポイントや特典が付与され、私には何も入ってきませんでした。相手のSNSのURLやTemu内での相手のユーザー名まで自分でまとめ提出したにも関わらず、詐欺まがいの行為をした人には「ペナルティは課せない」そうです。知名度が低いし「5個無料」と掲げている外国企業は警戒されなかなか招待に乗ってくれる友人がいませんでしたが、彼女たちが正解でした。少なくとも詐欺まがいの行為が罷り通るネットショップは、私は怖くて使えないです。即削除しました。

title: Fabulous, but make sure you read the small print!
content:
The app is fabulous, the customer service (from what I’ve experienced) is brilliant; the only thing you have to be careful of is making sure that you read the small print and are 100% certain that what you put in your basket is actually what you think it is.

There are a lot of dupes on here, most of which are marvellous and cost just a fraction of the price of the original; BUT some of the dupes have definitely been made without ever having the original product in front of the creator, and so the dupe sometimes doesn’t look / function in the same way that the original did.
For lots of things, this isn’t a major issue; but for toys - such as the Lego dupes - or maybe for things that you might want to look/function in a specific way, then the dupe just doesn’t quite cut the mustard…even though it’s usually 50+ % cheaper than the original. Sometimes you just need to buy the original. But for random bits and bobs, Temu is brilliant 👍

You do have to keep an eye on the prices though because they change all the time! And stock flies off the shelves sometimes, so be quick if you find something that you love, as it may not be there next time you look!!

Also: delivery. Typical delivery seems to be about 10 working days. The app will give you updates about your parcel along its journey; although I’ve found that the last leg of the journey (the bit after you get the message saying “your parcel has been received by the courier”) tends to give you no updates until the parcel is literally at your door! So if you see that your parcel is in the country, and you don’t want to miss your delivery, maybe just make sure that you’re around on the day if expected delivery 👍 (I feel like this lack of communication is possibly an Evri issue though, rather than a Temu one)

title: The truth about Temu
content:
Temu is an amazing online store and, if you order things from it (in my experience) it is really good! However, Temu does have a section to win free items by sharing the app with others so they can accept your invite. It makes you win every time saying, “You have won the ultimate amount of free items!”. What it doesn’t tell you is that it adds on more prizes, making it harder to redeem them and sometimes it doesn’t work.

Overall I would say to stick to buying things and get free items another way!

title: Loved it at first BUT…
content: First, I have placed many, many orders with Temu. Great buys, great offers, the first two shipments arrived within two days. Then that changes to 2+ weeks as the rest all comes from China. My problem with Temu is the blatantly deceptive “challenges”. Two days, CUMULATIVE from the time you choose the $50 free gift. Fine. You claim points for signing in etc, those challenges have “daily” next to it, and the points do accumulate for those tasks over two days. Now we get to the cost of this “2 day challenge “. $270, purchases are Cumulative. There is no time frame next to this in the two day challenge. But, remember, it says cumulative. So, you follow the instructions, you get to day 2, where you are able to claim points for that day. Then you notice, why did my purchases reset to 0?! I made over $100 dollars in purchases after I began this challenge! Called customer service (beyond useless), they kept telling me “there are rules”. I sent them screen prints of the rules and my progress, and my total cumulative purchase WERE over $250. But there are rules. Is this a translation issue? According to the English “rules”, I followed them to the letter. There is a definite sense of an authoritarian vibe here. Must follow the rules was what I repeatedly got from ‘customer service’. The 30 day price adjustment pledge, TAKEN AWAY because I requested  price adjustments, and refunds on items that arrived broken. (They rarely ship in boxes, usually just bags with lots of very tight tape.) Bottom line, avoid any challenges, try to refrain from requesting refunds on deceptive offers or price adjustments.

title: Very Obvious Marketing Scheme
content: It’s pretty obvious how they were able to market this app: entice people with the prospect of getting free stuff and insane discounts, then right before they checkout, force them to spam their friends and family to sign up in order to actually get it. They’ll take you through step after step of choosing all the stuff you want to get for free, then dangle it in front of them until they get that referral. And it’s crazy how you can never lose a deal in this app! I’m just always so lucky with all the deals I get! Spin a wheel, ALWAYS land on the best section. Flip a card, ALWAYS flip the best one. Even when I do it over again. Of course it’s so that you feel more pressure because who knows if you’ll be this lucky again? There’s always a catch too. Get 7 items for free, but you HAVE to buy 3 others. Get 4 items for free, but you HAVE to invite a friend. Get $200 in coupons, but it’s not actually $200 straight up. It’s a bundle of various coupons that can total in $200 in overall savings. So I can buy $50 worth of clothes, but not all the coupons are for clothes, or take 100% off the items I chose, so I still need to pay. I’d rather an app be honest about what I’m buying and how much I’m expected to pay rather than this bait and switch tactic they’re using. Cut all the theatrics, I’m buying low quality stuff from China just with more confetti and shiny popups before I hit the checkout button. Also, if you susceptible to buying under pressure, STAY AWAY from this app. There’s arbitrary timers everywhere and everything’s always almost sold out or in someone’s cart.

title: Addictive but unhealthy
content:
Played this game for about 3 months, started playing because of the puzzles it starts out easy with just a small commitment each day.
Not even super fun, but then I joined an alliance and started making friends in the game. I never spent money in the game and for to level 27 before deciding I had to quit. It takes more and more of your time and gets super addictive, till all you want to do is play.
Each level is more difficult to achieve without spending real money, although you can play and have fun as long as you're part of an active alliance. You will end up paying with time instead of money. There is strategy involved, but you'll never reach where you want to be when vou reach on goal there's another just out of reach. The game also has a steep learning curve, if you decide to really play you'll spend hours trying to figure out generals, buff, debuffs, research, ghosting, battlefield, server vs server, and everything else. There's always more to do to compete.
I'll say I enjoved while I played I made lots of friends had a great server, but in the end it took too much of my time so be aware what you're signing up for. This game can take upwards of ten hours and day and you can't go long without signing on or you'll be zeroed by other plavers and loose all your troops and

title: Temu is fantastic at what they do
content:
This would be five stars, except for the fact that Temu is too good. I have to admit that I am finding over 90% of the products I purchase through Temu to be of anywhere between reasonable and really good quality for a great price. My challenge is that I feel like I’m spending a bit too much of my disposable income because their algorithms know what I want and put it in front of my face. It’s too easy.

I would like to ask Temu in this forum to provide English translations of ingredients lists for people who have sensitive skin issues or allergies.
My orders tend to come in on time, sometimes early. They are excellent with notifications if you ask for them. The very few times my orders were late they were usually only by a day. When they were late, they automatically gave me a five dollar credit as promised.

Now I’m just giving little gifts to people because I see little things that are perfect for somebody and it’s cheap so I go ahead and buy it.
So yeah, pros and cons as far as Temu’s personal impact on my life. Otherwise, I would give them a five. Because they are the best at what they do.

It’s not terrible though and I will wear on occasions

title: Cheap and Manipulative
content:
Everything on the app is dirt cheap in price and value, as it’s made in a Chinese sweatshop. This should be obvious but I have to point it out. The app itself is designed like a microtransaction pay to play game, with all of these little gimmicks trying to get you to “win money” or “get free items” but they are all designed to make you spend even more money. There’s one where they promise a free item and let you choose it. But then you have to earn it by grinding on this app day after day, sending links to friends, pretending to feed these fish, and the closer you get to your goal the harder it makes it, where every drop in the bucket “feeding the fish” contributes less and less. It’s all a cheap scam. By the last day you’re able to do the event, each feeding contributes to 0.01% of the total for the one fish. It’s manipulative and a waste of time. If you want to buy the stuff, just use the website. The app also has built in ad trackers so they’re tracking your views and purchases and selling that information, just like Facebook and others do.

Also, as others have mentioned, the app steals your info. If I used this app, I’d be sure to have a VPN firewall on my phone like 1Blocker.

title: Bobbi Neal
content:
I have had so many problems with receiving my orders, it’s been extremely frustrating. They continue sending with USPS and they have shown why people don’t use then anymore and send emails instead. They can find my mailbox but my apartment.  I have over $300 dollars worth of orders returned because they don’t know how to read address’s. They can’t even ask the people in the office how to get to my place. I’ve asked for my orders to be sent UPS or FEDX but they prefer to have the orders returned. I received a few things which were ok. But the rugs for the bathroom and kitchen are being sent back, they are cheep and not worth the small amount you pay for them. They do have things that you can’t find anywhere else, but they aren’t significantly important. Things that make some things easier like clips to hold plastic bags in place.

The sheets don’t fit, the toilet seat is flimsy and won’t hold up. The self sticking holders for mops. brooms etc. don’t stay on the wall, and the things for the bottom of the door doesn’t stick either. The 20 oz cold cups keep things nice and cold, but the handles break, and if you don’t drive, good luck returning them, especially seeing they ship everything in plastic bags instead of boxes.

It’s a two way street. They carry a lot of little things that are not in the stools yet, cheep versions that look good but you don’t want them because they don’t fit or are made poorly and don’t last long. So you Will have to make up your own minds about what you think, but don’t expect anything a millionaire would buy, except maybe to give someone they didn’t want to buy a nice thing for most.

title: I am absolutely blown away!
content:
I have placed two orders, mainly of demon shorts and short sleeve shirts.
The shirts are not designer quality but nor should they expected to be for the price. No issues with the tailoring but if I was to be hyper critical, the cheaper buttons are somewhat of a give away. So impactive, light fitting and do not show any sweat at all. Considering I wore them on holiday, facing temperatures of late 20s and in bustling hot bars and I was sweating profusely at times, zero sweat marks . A massive plus point for me.
The demon shorts are truly excellent. Good thick heavy quality and look much more expensive than their price.
Delivery has been unexpectedly quick , much much quicker than another similar overseas site which is nowhere near within the same league as Temu.
My deliveries were 8/9 days .
IMPORTANT, sizes. Everything for me was on the large size for all my orders.
I am 5’11, and of a fairly stocky yet athletic physique. I have a 45.5 inch chest and 34 inch waist. I weigh 14 stone. On the High Street I range between a size medium and large, mainly a large. I like my shirts fitted, yet not skin tight . The medium sized shirts fit ok, but are baggier than what is typical for medium fit , leading me to ordering a small for three out of my four shirts on my second order.  I’ve never been a small since my mid to late teens so i must obviously say, having obtained approximately a dozen shirts, that the sizes are definitely on the large side. In fact I ordered one or two larges on my first order due to them looking very tightly fitted on the model and having considered the size chart. They were HUGE. I had the return them.
The returns were seamlessly smooth. Full refund, no issues. Definitely increased my buying confidence. Overall, really happy. FIVE stars.

title: Half legitimate half scam
content:
The stuff is ok and opening offers good and some of the referral program is reasonable but the “free gifts” and some for the other offers are a complete scam.

Below is something a wrote to their customer service which I think covers my points:

I have been using Temu for months now and happy with the products and have recommended it to others also. I understand the model of rewarding this and appreciate the “tricks” and polices designed to do this and have no issue with this. I recently went to get my “free gifts” however through the fishland “game” and found this just ridiculous! The scallimg down of rewards and the pace of progress and extra food needed for each fish etc is beyond frustrating. I have recommended several friends to the app (most of which wothout any “credit” due to the time frame placed on referrals which i think is a mistake but your choice) but i am now actively telling them all to avoid the fishland complete scam as that is what it is! I will not be recommenidng anyone else to the app from now on and am also debating stopping using it myself. This “promotion” is taking things way too far and will create far more dissatyfied customers than happy ones and i wanted to share my thoughts and feedback as skirting the line with promotions and referlals and blatent gamesmanship had been done well uptil this but the balamce on this is way off and beyond annoying. You have done a good job in so many other areas but this makes defending Temu from those who claim its not legitimate really difficult and i dont beleive you wish to irritate or annoy your custoners and put them off from recommending your app to others. I have taken my time here not referring people to your site of for own benefit but hoepfully providing you with some feedback others may feel but not share in the hopes it helps you and less of your customers have this very dissnegaging experience.

title: Cheap Prices but the free items are a scam
content:
I first downloaded this and got some great items at a great deal, I’ve ordered once since and my husband downloaded this due to the amazing deal I got. He has tried to do the “hat trick” thing they keep sending. He got it all the way to 99.5 points, .5 points away from getting everything sent to him. He got the .5 and when he went to claim it, it dropped .5 points off his total, then added the new .5 points, keeping him from winning like so many other users had “already won”. I also got tired of trying with the hat trick game but decided to try it without doing a single thing to earn me points. It said share to double my points, I hit the X and it still gave me the points. It said invite a new user get 100 points, I again hit the X, and it added the 100 points. Every time I have done this game, it’s the exact same, get two items you picked, energy, share to get energy, another item, energy, invite for energy, no more energy to retrieve the last item. It always stops you 14 points away from getting all items free.
It also pushes it’s “free items” you can win. There is no winning. It pushes side games to keep you in the app.
I’m making first aid kits for each family member this year for Christmas (we are a weird family) so getting the medical supplies for the kits are great prices, I can’t speak to quality for any of the things outside of my one first aid kit purchase but I am extremely diligent when I purchase. I check reviews, shop for the best price, and will wait for a month before I make a purchase waiting for the lowest possible price. If you don’t shop like that, I imagine you get the “Temu” items.

Anyways, it just makes no sense to have such a program and they were just gna waste our time when I’m actually a pretty loyal customer. Def a cheat there y’all. Don’t be like me. Don’t waste your time on it.

title: Whole new wardrobe.
content: I got rid of my shabby shoes, styleless purses, old lady jewelry, worn T-shirts, and tops I’d had for like forever and only wore once a year or so. Saves on shipping, but then I only get one return per delivery and occasionally, more than one item is less than satisfactory. I try to give helpful, honest reviews, but who wants to bother with odds and ends I only paid $1.95 for. So I have to choose only one item and, of course it’s the most expensive one. Then I just donate the others and am just out the money. Also, the algorithm causes my latest interest to show up cheaper AFTER I’ve ordered an paid for a more expensive identical item. Stop, already!  I already bought it!  Anyway, with the mucho bucks I’ve spent and I review EVERY item, Temu needs to give me a job!!

title: Leider für mich (und viele andere) nicht nutzbar..
content:
Wenn man Wohnhaft ist in Frankreich (oder einem anderen Land) aber keine Telefonnummer von diesem Land hat, ist es nicht möglich einzukaufen. In meinem Fall lebe ich in Frankreich, habe aber noch eine deutsche Nummer (was in Europa recht normal ist durch eu roaming und flat), kann aber in Frankreich nur eine Frz. Nummer angeben. Die Ländervorwahl lässt sich nicht ändern. So hab ich mir Sachen von mehreren hundert Euro ausgesucht und im Warenkorb kann ich wegen der Nummer den Einkauf nicht abschließen. Wäre super wenn man einfach die Vorwahl auswählen könnte und diese sich nicht abhängig macht von dem Wohnort. Auch etwa 300 weitere Personen alleine hier in meinem Betrieb sind betroffen, die es nicht nutzen könnten, wenn sie denn wollten.

Update: ich nutze nun irgendeine Nummer aus Frankreich, bin dadurch zwar nur per mail erreichbar aber erste Bestellung hat geklappt. Alles super 👌 Sobald ich meine Handynummer eintragen kann gibts 5* 👍

低評価レビューを見てからアプリインストールを考える身なのですが、実際に使ってみると低評価の理由に違和感がありました。

荷物の追跡ができないという件は、どうやら梱包が終わり次第追跡できるように番号を教えてくれることが原因です。
あらかじめ伝票を貰っているからできることで、日本で運送が始まるまでは追跡できないとのこと。海外から来るのと、即日配達に慣れているから感じることだと思います。

招待コインが無くなったという件は、小さな文字ですがきちんと使用期限が明記されています。

たぶん他の低評価も、内容次第では勘違いや細部まで見ていないことなどが原因のものもあると思います。

商品は安いですが、最低の使用金額が決まっています。ちょこっとだけ買うのが逆に難しいかもです

title: Failed to deliver
content:
I placed a delivery on the 9th of August and expected delivery for 7-9 days later. On the 8th day I got an email saying that they tried to deliver but I was not home to receive the parcel so it was being sent back to sender. I was home at the time of the stated attempt and there was no one at the door, i had also chosen for my order to be delivered to a local stores in-post and not my house so that was strange. I texted through Temu’s customer support and the first time they were very unhelpful, just kept saying when I should expect my delivery. My second attempt on the customer support was better, a report was made about my missing parcel and I got an update a few days later (24th August) confirming that it was a failed delivery and the senders had received the package again. I was issued a £10 credit to spend on the app as way of apology.
As my first experience of Temu, I am very dissatisfied and I am unlikely to order from here again.

title: Warning: Careful Use! CC Only!
content:
– Use your credit card or paypal with purchase (fraud) prevention. Never link your bank account to Temu. I used my credit card ("CC") exclusively with Temu, and a month later after I started using Temu, my CC company alerted me that someone tried to charge my card for $400. The charge was declined, and I'll be getting a new one soon. If it weren't for my CC fraud protection, I would be out on that money. – Deceptive sales techniques with giveaways & coupons that prey on people who fall for 'sunk cost fallacy' games. If you play their fish/farm games, points become incrementally harder to obtain. You'll soon see +0.01 for an action that previously increased the point by +5, for instance. It's a time sink. They only reward you more points if you give them free advertising by inviting friends that are new users. They make sure they're new by keeping track of device information, not Temu account. – There are good deals on the app, but at what cost? It is safer to shop with trusted vendors. Temu is not one of them.
– Seller photos aren't aways accurate. Example: I ordered a lunch box with stainless steel interiors (trays) that can be taken out. Photos showed all the stainless steel parts, yet the actual items that arrived had them all omitted. Customer service refused to do anything to rectify it.

title: Pretty cool, but the free stuff isn’t all that free
content:
So far, I’ve experimented with the experience of using the app and while the whole experience is based around users impulsively spending money and inviting more people to download the app, the app also offers a bunch of free stuff. The only catch is, you better be in it for the long game because there's plenty of opportunity for them to 'get you' and drain you of your time and energy in the meantime. It's very misleading and they continue to change the rules and how their games are played. For example, there's a mini game called Fishland and you have to feed a certain amount of fish to win free goods, except the fish gradually become harder to feed and take more food to feed them, It also get gradually harder to get fish food and takes longer and longer. It's a constant dangling of the carrot. It's meant to frustrate you and make you break down and just buy what they're offering.

I'll give a higher rating when the mini games and free offers feel less like a carnival game and make it worth my time.. probably would incentivize me to buy more by not feeling gyped all the time.

title: Linked to forced labor in China & half the products are junk
content:
The LA times has a story about how some products on Temu are from a region that the US has banned products from because it is where companies are using forced labor camps from imprisoned ethnic minorities. I did not realize this when I decided to try temu, I wish I had known.
And you get what you pay for…of the 25 items I ordered, 11 were so bad I returned them or threw them away. Some were totally defective (like a meat tenderizer that the silver finish rubbed off and turned my hands black when i tried to wash it with regular dish soap), some were  not as pictured/described (weird gathering stitches on a blouse, ‘stretchy’ shoelaces that weren’t actually stretchy at all, shorts where the fabric in person is shiny and stiff instead of matte and drapey the way it looked in the photos), some seem possibly dangerous (a dog cooling mat that was cool but must have some weird chemicals on it b/c my dog who loves to lay on EVERYTHING refuses to go near it).
So basically it seems too good to be true and it definitely is. The one good thing is returns were easy and customer support was helpful when I had to contact them. But the forced labor thing is awful, I will never buy from them again.

title: Great shop BUT
content:
Update: I have now heard from two people that their cards/accounts linked to Temu have been drained. So yeah one star. If you don't have it yet, don't get it. Stay safe.

I love that I can get decent quality stuff for low prices. I've spent quite a lot because so many things are so cheap. Temu is smart because they use games where you can win products or store credit, to keep you coming back. (Instead of buying a bunch of stuff once and then never using the app again.) Even smarter, the games often require you to complete tasks like browse for thirty seconds, make purchases, or interact with existing users or recommend new users. Here's the issue. They made the games ridiculously easy to win for the first few months, even without referring a new user, and EVERYONE was cashing out. Then they changed all of the games to be rigged so that you can't win without recommending someone new. But a lot of the games pretend to be chance/luck based. Spin the wheel types, but it's not really luck or chance at all. It's obviously calculated to be unwinnable and it's really frustrating and a bit insulting. I wish they would make the games ACTUALLY chance based, even if that means offering smaller prizes. The way they do it now makes them seem really skeevy and scammy, and damages the trust of their users.

I’m not sure how this money gimmick thing works. If I score for free money great but I’m more than happy with the prices paid and the quality of the products.

I wouldn’t hesitate to purchase from Temu again and would recommend giving them a try at least once.

title: App is great but games are almost impossible to win
content:
I’m currently playing the fish game where you have to feed all the fish and then you get points for doing that and then you can get the stuff you picked out for free and with free shipping. it was easy at first but I didn’t expect it to stay easy. Don’t give me wrong the app self is great. Prices are awesome. I just feel like It should be easier to win these games and you should be able to win the game without having to invite other users to the app.

title: I have a problem and I need help!
content:
This app seems so gimmicky and fake. I would never have been a believer if a coworker hadn’t shared  about the things she got when I complimented her. She said it was addictive. I was very apprehensive at first, but I finally made my first order, then got sucked into earning free gifts. Some of the items are garbage, but the sports bras and kitchen gadgets have been so nice. Most of the clothes and shoes are great quality. Look at the photos closely and read the reviews. I even got a FREE $50 auto cat feeder that totally works! What’s even more shocking is their amazing return policy.

I’ve heard that Temu had a bad reputation and people didn’t get their packages, but this was back during COVID when shipping overseas was super slow anyway. I seriously don’t think I go a week without shopping on Temu, and I usually receive it in about 7 days. So there’s the waiting…🙇🏻‍♀️ I do research, and certain things are worth buying, and certain things are not. My daughter got some wireless headphones as a free gift doesn’t love them. They work ok, but they don’t have ventilation, so they’re hot and uncomfortable. But it was free, so what can you do? I wouldn’t purchase cheap electronics. And make sure you pick a free gift that you would actually enjoy or give as a gift to someone else.

The app really does everything imaginable to get you to have others sign up. This is how you get free gifts. It’s pretty genius 💡 . Unless you are an influencer or have a huge following, that list will exhaust itself pretty quick. But besides all that, I have been pleased with most of the items and MOST IMPORTANTLY, their free return policy. Sometimes, I don’t even have to return the items and they give me a credit to use right away.  That’s probably because I almost always have more items on the way and in my cart. Be on the lookout for a TEMU recovery group. It’s no joke. Shop with caution ⚠️

The other games are the exact same.

The company is not doing themselves any favors, nor are they doing their customers any favors by not making their app, website, and emails accessible.

title: Verstehe manche Bewertungen nicht
content:
Der eine gibt Sterne Abzug, weil er zu faul ist im Internet nach seiner Frage zu googeln, ein anderer verläuft sich im Chinesen Klitschee.

Also für alle mal eine schriftliche Bewertung:
Es gibt einen Warenhaus in Deutschland, weshalb meine Bestellungen idR. innerhalb 5 Tagen ankamen. Die Verpackung war typisch China, aber alle Produkte, bis auf Kleinigkeiten, genau wie erwartet. Versand läuft über DHL.

Testet doch einfach eine Bestellung, bei der ihr so wenig wie möglich ausgibt, um zu sehen wie sich die neue Konkurrenz so schlägt, ehe ihr Bewertungen verfasst, die ich nach meiner Erfahrung unmöglich nachvollziehen kann.

title: I love it!! But…
content:
I have been using Temu for a few weeks now. If you aren’t familiar Temu gives out free items for inviting new people to the app. Great right? And I have done this many time and had even managed to win 8 free items of my choice! I was very happy for that, and I can assure you it’s not a scam. BUT, this whole idea is you get given three FREE items of your choice by inviting three friends to the app so they can take part in claiming prizes. So say I invite three friends, them friends invite three friends, and that goes for them three friends inviting other friend and so on.

❗️THIS IS A PYRAMID SCHEME!!!❗️

Temu is using you by leering you in by offering free items, so you invite as many people as possible to use the app. So in some way you are getting free items out of your on stupidity.

Now I don’t particularly have anything against the app because I have ordered things off temu for cheap prices and I have had pleasant experiences. And even if your package gets delayed they will usually give you credit ( I received £5 due to a delay!). It’s very similar to aliexpress, shein, wish ect… So this isn’t particularly a review to complain, but mainly just to tell people that this app is a blatantly clear pyramid scheme, which is even illegal is one countries. So I just want to make you aware of the Temu’s ‘plan’. But excluding THAT I love temu it’s a great service, very affordable and has a wide range of products!! I would recommend this app, but remember, most of the time receiving free things have a catch!

content: I love Temu…almost too much! It’s great for customers that are okay with knockoffs. For some things like arts and crafts, they’re amazing. Good luck and happy Temu shopping!!!

title: ‘Giveaway’ is a scam
content: I was doing the ‘Hat-Trick Draw’ game to win a number of items, but they make it incredibly hard to actually win. After getting all the free energy points, I needed about 16 energy left within 24 hours, and the only way to get more energy was to invite friends. Here’s where the scam takes place. They report you can have up to 3 existing accounts  accept your invite for 1-3 energy a piece, or have new users register using your generated game link for an unlimited amount of times which would give you 1-5 energy a piece. Issue is that when your needed energy goes below 12, it doesn’t give you 1-3 or 1-5, it gives 1. One. A single energy. So after 24 hours of soliciting my friends and family to download an app that’s promising me a free item bundle, I make it down to only 1 energy needed (meaning I have more or less needlessly got 10-15 of my contacts to click a sketchy link just to help me) when the hard stop timer resets and kills my game. Because Temu lied about how much energy they would ACTUALLY give you per successful invite, I wasted 24 hours of time and annoyed relatives and made them think they were risking their internet security to get literally nothing out of it. Don’t waste your time.

title: Very Impressed
content:
Very good quality items for the price and are as shown in the app. Bought several ties, suit vests, and collectibles from here at incredible prices! Aside from shipping times ranging from 2-3 weeks, the price and selection here is fantastic. You can find anything from 99 cent jewelry to entire gaming consoles!

The free gift system, like the money tree and the fishing game in the app, is very much geared towards getting new users to sign up. Overall the app performed better than expected, items were as shown and the new selections they have every day make me genuinely excited to purchase more items. This app has made gift giving an adventure once again!

content: Originally, I thought the app was very gimmicky— and really didn’t have great expectations. There is something there for everyone— check it out, and read reviews. Also, if you do shopping on Etsy, I recommend checking on this site that the same product isn’t being sold on Temu for less than half the price it’s listed on Etsy.

content:

title: Mit Vorsicht zu genießen
content: Über die Qualität der Produkte kann ich aktuell noch nichts sagen, aber das ganze Gutschein-Zeug ist sehr unseriös. Man bekommt z.B. ein Gutschein Paket angeboten, wenn man innerhalb von 24h 2 „beliebige“ Dinge aus einer Liste mit ausgewählten Produkten bestellt. Eher zufällig bekommt man mit, dass man einen Mindestbestellwert erreichen muss - den man aber gar nicht erreichen kann, weil man diesen Wert nur durch Bestellungen bei einem Händler erreichen muss. So wird das aber nicht kommuniziert. Man verbringt ewig damit, was Passendes zu finden, nur um dann festzustellen, dass ein Teil der Bestellung nicht aufgegeben wird. Die Folge: Entweder man lässt es oder man bestellt sinnlos irgendwelches Zeug. Und genau diese Praxis (nebst einigen andern) führte dazu, dass diese zusätzlichen Zollgebühren eingeführt wurden, über die sich hier so viele beschweren.
